sanskrit: निदाघो नाम वै मुनिः पप्रच्छ ऋभुं भगवन्तमात्मानात्मविवेकमनुब्रूहीति । स होवाच ऋभुः । सर्ववाचोऽवधिर्ब्रह्म सर्वचिन्तावधिर्गुरुः । सर्वकारणकार्यात्मा कार्यकारणवर्जितः
translit: nidāgho nāma vai muniḥ papraccha ṛbhuṃ bhagavantamātmānātmavivekamanubrūhīti | sa hovāca ṛbhuḥ | sarvavāco'vadhirbrahma sarvacintāvadhirguruḥ | sarvakāraṇakāryātmā kāryakāraṇavarjitaḥ
en: The sage named Nidagha asked the revered Ribhu: "Tell me the discrimination between Self and non-Self." Ribhu said: Brahman is the limit of all speech; the teacher is the limit of all thought; the Self of all cause and effect, free of effect and cause;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The sage named Nidagha पूछा the revered Ribhu: "Tell me the discrimination between Self and non-Self." Ribhu कहा: परब्रह्म is the limit of all speech; गुरुदेव is the limit of all thought; आत्मा of all cause and effect, free of effect and cause;।

sanskrit: सर्वसङ्कल्परहितः सर्वनादमयः शिवः । सर्ववर्जितचिन्मात्रः सर्वानन्दमयः परः
translit: sarvasaṅkalparahitaḥ sarvanādamayaḥ śivaḥ | sarvavarjitacinmātraḥ sarvānandamayaḥ paraḥ
en: free of all intentions, Shiva made of all sound; pure consciousness free of all, supreme, made of all bliss;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: free of all intentions, Shiva made of all sound; pure चैतन्य free of all, supreme, made of all bliss;।

sanskrit: सर्वतेजःप्रकाशात्मा नादानन्दमयात्मकः । सर्वानुभवनिर्मुक्तः सर्वध्यानविवर्जितः
translit: sarvatejaḥprakāśātmā nādānandamayātmakaḥ | sarvānubhavanirmuktaḥ sarvadhyānavivarjitaḥ
en: of the nature of the light of all radiance, made of the bliss of nada; freed from all experience, free of all meditation;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: of the nature of the light of all radiance, made of the bliss of nada; freed from all experience, free of all ध्यान/उपासना;।

sanskrit: सर्वनादकलातीत एष आत्माहमव्ययः । आत्मानात्मविवेकादिभेदाभेदविवर्जितः
translit: sarvanādakalātīta eṣa ātmāhamavyayaḥ | ātmānātmavivekādibhedābhedavivarjitaḥ
en: beyond all the parts of nada, this Self, I am, imperishable; free of the distinctions and non-distinctions of discrimination between Self and non-Self and the like;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: beyond all the parts of nada, this Self, I am, imperishable; free of the distinctions and non-distinctions of discrimination between Self and non-Self and the like;।

sanskrit: शान्ताशान्तादिहीनात्मा नादान्तर्ज्योतिरूपकः । महावाक्यार्थतो दूरो ब्रह्मास्मीत्यतिदूरतः
translit: śāntāśāntādihīnātmā nādāntarjyotirūpakaḥ | mahāvākyārthato dūro brahmāsmītyatidūrataḥ
en: the Self devoid of peaceful and unpeaceful and the like, of the form of the light within nada; far from the meaning of the great sayings, very far from "I am Brahman";
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा devoid of peaceful and unpeaceful and the like, of the form of the light within nada; far from the meaning of the great sayings, very far from "I am परब्रह्म";।

sanskrit: तच्छब्दवर्ज्यस्त्वंशब्दहीनो वाक्यार्थवर्जितः । क्षराक्षरविहीनो यो नादान्तर्ज्योतिरेव सः
translit: tacchabdavarjyastvaṃśabdahīno vākyārthavarjitaḥ | kṣarākṣaravihīno yo nādāntarjyotireva saḥ
en: free of the word "that," devoid of the word "thou," free of the meaning of the sentence; devoid of perishable and imperishable — he is only the light within nada.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: free of the word "that," devoid of the word "thou," free of the meaning of the sentence; devoid of perishable and imperishable — he is only the light within nada.।

sanskrit: अखण्डैकरसो वाहमानन्दोऽस्मीति वर्जितः । सर्वातीतस्वभावात्मा नादान्तर्ज्योतिरेव सः
translit: akhaṇḍaikaraso vāhamānando'smīti varjitaḥ | sarvātītasvabhāvātmā nādāntarjyotireva saḥ
en: Free even of "I am undivided one-savor bliss"; of the nature beyond all — he is only the light within nada.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Free even of "I am undivided one-savor bliss"; of the nature beyond all — he is only the light within nada.।

sanskrit: आत्मेति शब्दहीनो य आत्मशब्दार्थवर्जितः । सच्चिदानन्दहीनो य एषैवात्मा सनातनः
translit: ātmeti śabdahīno ya ātmaśabdārthavarjitaḥ | saccidānandahīno ya eṣaivātmā sanātanaḥ
en: He who is devoid of the word "Self," free of the meaning of the word Self, devoid even of being-consciousness-bliss, this alone is the eternal Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He who is devoid of the word "Self," free of the meaning of the word Self, devoid even of being-चैतन्य-bliss, this alone is the eternal Self.।

sanskrit: स निर्देष्टुमशक्यो यो वेदवाक्यैरगम्यतः । यस्य किञ्चिद्बहिर्नास्ति किञ्चिदन्तः कियन्न च
translit: sa nirdeṣṭumaśakyo yo vedavākyairagamyataḥ | yasya kiñcidbahirnāsti kiñcidantaḥ kiyanna ca
en: He cannot be pointed to, being unreachable by Vedic sentences; for whom there is nothing outside, nothing inside, nothing at all.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: He cannot be pointed to, being unreachable by Vedic sentences; for whom there is nothing outside, nothing inside, nothing at all.।

sanskrit: यस्य लिङ्गं प्रपञ्चं वा ब्रह्मैवात्मा न संशयः । नास्ति यस्य शरीरं वा जीवो वा भूतभौतिकः
translit: yasya liṅgaṃ prapañcaṃ vā brahmaivātmā na saṃśayaḥ | nāsti yasya śarīraṃ vā jīvo vā bhūtabhautikaḥ
en: Of whom there is no mark or world — Brahman alone is the Self; no doubt. For whom there is no body, no individual, no elements or elemental things,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Of whom there is no mark or world — परब्रह्म alone is आत्मा; no doubt. For whom there is no body, no individual, no elements or elemental things,।

sanskrit: नामरूपादिकं नास्ति भोज्यं वा भोगभुक्च वा । सद्वाऽसद्वा स्थितिर्वापि यस्य नास्ति क्षराक्षरम्
translit: nāmarūpādikaṃ nāsti bhojyaṃ vā bhogabhukca vā | sadvā'sadvā sthitirvāpi yasya nāsti kṣarākṣaram
en: no name and form and the like, no object of enjoyment or enjoyer; for whom there is no existent or non-existent, no state, no perishable or imperishable —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: no name and form and the like, no object of enjoyment or enjoyer; for whom there is no existent or non-existent, no state, no perishable or imperishable —।

sanskrit: गुणं वा विगुणं वापि सम आत्मा न संशयः । यस्य वाच्यं वाचकं वा श्रवणं मननं च वा
translit: guṇaṃ vā viguṇaṃ vāpi sama ātmā na saṃśayaḥ | yasya vācyaṃ vācakaṃ vā śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ ca vā
en: with quality or without quality, the Self is even; no doubt. For whom there is no speakable or speaker, no hearing or reflection,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: with quality or without quality, आत्मा is even; no doubt. For whom there is no speakable or speaker, no hearing or reflection,।

sanskrit: गुरुशिष्यादिभेदं वा देवलोकाः सुरासुराः । यत्र धर्ममधर्मं वा शुद्धं वाशुद्धमण्वपि
translit: guruśiṣyādibhedaṃ vā devalokāḥ surāsurāḥ | yatra dharmamadharmaṃ vā śuddhaṃ vāśuddhamaṇvapi
en: no difference of teacher and disciple and the like, no worlds of gods, gods or demons; where there is no merit or demerit, not even an atom of pure or impure;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: no difference of teacher and disciple and the like, no worlds of gods, gods or demons; where there is no merit or demerit, not even an atom of pure or impure;।

sanskrit: यत्र कालमकालं वा निश्चयः संशयो न हि । यत्र मन्त्रममन्त्रं वा विद्याविद्ये न विद्यते
translit: yatra kālamakālaṃ vā niścayaḥ saṃśayo na hi | yatra mantramamantraṃ vā vidyāvidye na vidyate
en: where there is no time or non-time, no certainty or doubt; where there is no mantra or non-mantra; knowledge and ignorance do not exist;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: where there is no time or non-time, no certainty or doubt; where there is no mantra or non-mantra; ज्ञान and अविद्या do not exist;।

sanskrit: द्रष्टृदर्शनदृश्यं वा ईषन्मात्रं कलात्मकम् । अनात्मेति प्रसङ्गो वा ह्यनात्मेति मनोऽपि वा
translit: draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyaṃ vā īṣanmātraṃ kalātmakam | anātmeti prasaṅgo vā hyanātmeti mano'pi vā
en: no seer, seeing or seen, even slightly, no part; no occasion of "non-Self," no mind of "non-Self,"
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: no seer, seeing or seen, even slightly, no part; no occasion of "non-Self," no mind of "non-Self,।

sanskrit: अनात्मेति जगद्वापि नास्ति नास्ति निश्चिनु । सर्वसङ्कल्पशून्यत्वात्सर्वकार्यविवर्जनात्
translit: anātmeti jagadvāpi nāsti nāsti niścinu | sarvasaṅkalpaśūnyatvātsarvakāryavivarjanāt
en: nor "non-Self" as world — be certain it does not, does not exist. Because it is void of all intentions and free of all effects,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: nor "non-Self" as world — be certain it does not, does not exist. Because it is void of all intentions and free of all effects,।

sanskrit: केवलं ब्रह्ममात्रत्वान्नास्त्यनात्मेति निश्चिनु । देहत्रयविहीनत्वात्कालत्रयविवर्जनात्
translit: kevalaṃ brahmamātratvānnāstyanātmeti niścinu | dehatrayavihīnatvātkālatrayavivarjanāt
en: because it is merely Brahman alone, be certain there is no non-Self; because it is devoid of the three bodies, free of the three times,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: because it is merely परब्रह्म alone, be certain there is no non-Self; because it is devoid of the three bodies, free of the three times,।

sanskrit: जीवत्रयगुणाभावात्तापत्रयविवर्जनात् । लोकत्रयविहीनत्वात्सर्वमात्मेति शासनात्
translit: jīvatrayaguṇābhāvāttāpatrayavivarjanāt | lokatrayavihīnatvātsarvamātmeti śāsanāt
en: because the qualities of the three individuals are absent, because the three afflictions are absent, because it is devoid of the three worlds, by the teaching "all is the Self."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: because the qualities of the three individuals are absent, because the three afflictions are absent, because it is devoid of the three worlds, by the teaching "all is आत्मा.।

sanskrit: चित्ताभाच्चिन्तनीयं देहाभावाज्जरा न च । पादाभावाद्गतिर्नास्ति हस्ताभावात्क्रिया न च
translit: cittābhāccintanīyaṃ dehābhāvājjarā na ca | pādābhāvādgatirnāsti hastābhāvātkriyā na ca
en: For lack of mind there is nothing to think; for lack of body there is no old age; for lack of feet there is no going; for lack of hands there is no action;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: For lack of mind there is nothing to think; for lack of body there is no old age; for lack of feet there is no going; for lack of hands there is no action;।

sanskrit: मृत्युर्नास्ति जनाभावाद्बुद्ध्यभावात्सुखादिकम् । धर्मो नास्ति शुचिर्नास्ति सत्यं नास्ति भयं न च
translit: mṛtyurnāsti janābhāvādbuddhyabhāvātsukhādikam | dharmo nāsti śucirnāsti satyaṃ nāsti bhayaṃ na ca
en: there is no death for lack of people; for lack of intellect there is no pleasure and the like; there is no merit, no purity, no truth, no fear;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: there is no death for lack of people; for lack of intellect there is no pleasure and the like; there is no merit, no purity, no truth, no fear;।

sanskrit: अक्षरोच्चारणं नास्ति गुरुशिष्यादि नास्त्यपि । एकाभावे द्वितीयं न न द्वितीये न चैकता
translit: akṣaroccāraṇaṃ nāsti guruśiṣyādi nāstyapi | ekābhāve dvitīyaṃ na na dvitīye na caikatā
en: no utterance of syllables, no teacher and disciple; where there is no one, there is no second; and not in the second is there oneness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: no utterance of syllables, no teacher and disciple; where there is no one, there is no second; and not in the second is there oneness.।

sanskrit: सत्यत्वमस्ति चेत्किञ्चिदसत्यं न च सम्भवेत् । असत्यत्वं यदि भवेत्सत्यत्वं न घटिष्यति
translit: satyatvamasti cetkiñcidasatyaṃ na ca sambhavet | asatyatvaṃ yadi bhavetsatyatvaṃ na ghaṭiṣyati
en: If there were anything of truth, falsehood could not arise; if there were falsehood, truth would not be tenable.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If there were anything of truth, falsehood could not arise; if there were falsehood, truth would not be tenable.।

sanskrit: शुभं यद्यशुभं विद्धि अशुभाच्छुभमिष्यते । भयं यद्यभवं विद्धि अभयाद्भयमापतेत्
translit: śubhaṃ yadyaśubhaṃ viddhi aśubhācchubhamiṣyate | bhayaṃ yadyabhavaṃ viddhi abhayādbhayamāpatet
en: If you know the auspicious as inauspicious, the auspicious is wished from the inauspicious; if you know fear as non-existence, fear would fall from fearlessness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If you know the auspicious as inauspicious, the auspicious is wished from the inauspicious; if you know fear as non-existence, fear would fall from fearlessness.।

sanskrit: बन्धत्वमपि चेन्मोक्षो बन्धाभावे क्व मोक्षता । मरणं यदि चेज्जन्म जन्माभावे मृतिर्न च
translit: bandhatvamapi cenmokṣo bandhābhāve kva mokṣatā | maraṇaṃ yadi cejjanma janmābhāve mṛtirna ca
en: If bondage exists, so does liberation; without bondage where is liberation? If there is death, there is birth; without birth there is no death.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If bondage exists, so does मोक्ष; without bondage where is मोक्ष? If there is death, there is birth; without birth there is no death.।

sanskrit: त्वमित्यपि भवेच्चाहं त्वं नो चेदहमेव न । इदं यदि तदेवास्ति तदभादिदं न च
translit: tvamityapi bhaveccāhaṃ tvaṃ no cedahameva na | idaṃ yadi tadevāsti tadabhādidaṃ na ca
en: If there is "you," there is "I"; if not "you," there is not "I"; if this exists, that exists; without that appearing, this does not.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If there is "you," there is "I"; if not "you," there is not "I"; if this exists, that exists; without that appearing, this does not.।

sanskrit: अस्तीति चेन्नास्ति तदा नास्ति चेदस्ति किञ्चन । कार्यं चेत्कारणं किञ्चित्कार्याभावे न कारणम्
translit: astīti cennāsti tadā nāsti cedasti kiñcana | kāryaṃ cetkāraṇaṃ kiñcitkāryābhāve na kāraṇam
en: If it exists, then it does not; if it does not exist, then something does; if there is effect, there is some cause; without effect there is no cause.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If it exists, then it does not; if it does not exist, then something does; if there is effect, there is some cause; without effect there is no cause.।

sanskrit: द्वैतं यदि तदाऽद्वैतं द्वैताभावे द्वयं न च । दृश्यं यदि दृगप्यस्ति दृश्याभावे दृगेन न
translit: dvaitaṃ yadi tadā'dvaitaṃ dvaitābhāve dvayaṃ na ca | dṛśyaṃ yadi dṛgapyasti dṛśyābhāve dṛgena na
en: If there is duality, then non-duality; without duality there is no pair; if there is the seen, there is the seer; without the seen, no seer.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If there is duality, then non-duality; without duality there is no pair; if there is the seen, there is the seer; without the seen, no seer.।

sanskrit: अन्तर्यदि बहिः सत्यमन्ता भावे बहिर्न च । पूर्णत्वमस्ति चेत्किञ्चिदपूर्णत्वं प्रसज्यते
translit: antaryadi bahiḥ satyamantā bhāve bahirna ca | pūrṇatvamasti cetkiñcidapūrṇatvaṃ prasajyate
en: If inside, then outside is true; without inside there is no outside; if there is fullness, there arises some non-fullness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If inside, then outside is true; without inside there is no outside; if there is fullness, there arises some non-fullness.।

sanskrit: तस्मादेतत्क्वचिन्नास्ति त्वं चाहं वा इमे इदम् । नास्ति दृष्टान्तिकं सत्ये नास्ति दार्ष्टान्तिकं ह्यजे
translit: tasmādetatkvacinnāsti tvaṃ cāhaṃ vā ime idam | nāsti dṛṣṭāntikaṃ satye nāsti dārṣṭāntikaṃ hyaje
en: Therefore none of this exists anywhere: you, I, these, this; in the truth there is no illustrated, in the unborn no illustrator.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Therefore none of this exists anywhere: you, I, these, this; in the truth there is no illustrated, in the unborn no illustrator.।

sanskrit: परम्ब्रह्माहमस्मीति स्मरणस्य मनो न हि । ब्रह्ममात्रं जगदिदं ब्रह्ममात्रं त्वमप्यहम्
translit: parambrahmāhamasmīti smaraṇasya mano na hi | brahmamātraṃ jagadidaṃ brahmamātraṃ tvamapyaham
en: The mind has no place for remembering "I am the supreme Brahman." This world is Brahman alone; you and I are Brahman alone.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन has no place for remembering "I am the supreme परब्रह्म." This world is परब्रह्म alone; you and I are परब्रह्म alone.।

sanskrit: चिन्मात्रं केवलं चाहं नास्त्यनात्म्येति निश्चिनु । इदं प्रपञ्चं नास्त्येव नोत्पन्नं नो स्थितं क्वचित्
translit: cinmātraṃ kevalaṃ cāhaṃ nāstyanātmyeti niścinu | idaṃ prapañcaṃ nāstyeva notpannaṃ no sthitaṃ kvacit
en: I am pure consciousness alone; be certain there is no non-Self. This world does not exist at all, not arisen, nor standing anywhere.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am pure चैतन्य alone; be certain there is no non-Self. This world does not exist at all, not arisen, nor standing anywhere.।

sanskrit: चित्तं प्रपञ्चमित्याहुर्नास्ति नास्त्येव सर्वदा । न प्रपञ्चं न चित्तादि नाहङ्कारो न जीवकः
translit: cittaṃ prapañcamityāhurnāsti nāstyeva sarvadā | na prapañcaṃ na cittādi nāhaṅkāro na jīvakaḥ
en: They call the mind the world; it does not exist, it never exists; no world, no mind and the like, no ego, no individual.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: They call मन the world; it does not exist, it never exists; no world, no mind and the like, no ego, no individual.।

sanskrit: मायाकार्यादिकं नास्ति माया नास्ति भयं नहि । कर्ता नास्ति क्रिया नास्ति श्रवणं मननं नहि
translit: māyākāryādikaṃ nāsti māyā nāsti bhayaṃ nahi | kartā nāsti kriyā nāsti śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ nahi
en: No illusion or its effects; illusion does not exist, nor fear; no doer, no action, no hearing, no reflection.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No illusion or its effects; illusion does not exist, nor fear; no doer, no action, no hearing, no reflection.।

sanskrit: समाधिद्वितयं नास्ति मातृमानादि नास्ति हि । अज्ञानं चापि नास्त्येव ह्यविवेकं कदाचन
translit: samādhidvitayaṃ nāsti mātṛmānādi nāsti hi | ajñānaṃ cāpi nāstyeva hyavivekaṃ kadācana
en: No twofold samadhi, no knower, measure and the like; ignorance too does not exist, nor non-discrimination ever.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No twofold samadhi, no knower, measure and the like; अविद्या too does not exist, nor non-discrimination ever.।

sanskrit: अनुबन्धचतुष्कं न सम्बन्धत्रयमेव न । न गङ्गा न गया सेतुर्न भूतं नान्यदस्ति हि
translit: anubandhacatuṣkaṃ na sambandhatrayameva na | na gaṅgā na gayā seturna bhūtaṃ nānyadasti hi
en: No fourfold preliminary, nor threefold relation; no Ganga, no Gaya, no bridge, no being, no other.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No fourfold preliminary, nor threefold relation; no Ganga, no Gaya, no bridge, no being, no other.।

sanskrit: न भूमिर्न जलं नाग्निर्न न वायुर्न च खं क्वचित् । न देवा न च दिक्पाला न वेदा न गुरुः क्वचित्
translit: na bhūmirna jalaṃ nāgnirna na vāyurna ca khaṃ kvacit | na devā na ca dikpālā na vedā na guruḥ kvacit
en: No earth, no water, no fire, no wind, no sky anywhere; no gods, no guardians of the quarters, no Vedas, no teacher anywhere.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No earth, no water, no fire, no wind, no sky anywhere; no gods, no guardians of the quarters, no Vedas, no teacher anywhere.।

sanskrit: न दूरं नास्तिकं नालं न मध्यं न क्वचित्स्थितम् । नाद्वैतं द्वैतसत्यं वा ह्यसत्यं वा इदं न च
translit: na dūraṃ nāstikaṃ nālaṃ na madhyaṃ na kvacitsthitam | nādvaitaṃ dvaitasatyaṃ vā hyasatyaṃ vā idaṃ na ca
en: No far, no atheist, no end, no middle, nothing standing anywhere; no non-duality, no truth of duality, nor this untruth.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No far, no atheist, no end, no middle, nothing standing anywhere; no non-duality, no truth of duality, nor this untruth.।

sanskrit: बन्धमोक्षादिकं नास्ति सद्वाऽसद्वा सुखादि वा । जातिर्नास्ति गतिर्नास्ति वर्णो नास्ति न लौकिकम्
translit: bandhamokṣādikaṃ nāsti sadvā'sadvā sukhādi vā | jātirnāsti gatirnāsti varṇo nāsti na laukikam
en: No bondage, liberation and the like, existent or non-existent, pleasure and the like; no birth, no goal, no caste, no worldly thing.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No bondage, मोक्ष and the like, existent or non-existent, pleasure and the like; no birth, no goal, no caste, no worldly thing.।

sanskrit: सर्वं ब्रह्मेति नास्त्येव ब्रह्म इत्यपि नास्ति हि । चिदित्येवेति नास्त्येव चिदहम्भाषणं न हि
translit: sarvaṃ brahmeti nāstyeva brahma ityapi nāsti hi | cidityeveti nāstyeva cidahambhāṣaṇaṃ na hi
en: "All is Brahman" does not exist; even "Brahman" does not exist; "consciousness" does not exist; no speech "I am consciousness."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All is परब्रह्म" does not exist; even "परब्रह्म" does not exist; "चैतन्य" does not exist; no speech "I am चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि नास्त्येव नित्यशुद्धोऽस्मि न क्वचित् । वाचा यदुच्यते किञ्चिन्मनसा मनुते क्वचित्
translit: ahaṃ brahmāsmi nāstyeva nityaśuddho'smi na kvacit | vācā yaducyate kiñcinmanasā manute kvacit
en: "I am Brahman" does not exist; "I am eternally pure" is nowhere; whatever is said by speech, thought by mind anywhere,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म" does not exist; "I am eternally pure" is nowhere; whatever is कहा by speech, thought by mind anywhere,।

sanskrit: बुद्ध्या निश्चिनुते नास्ति चित्तेन ज्ञायते नहि । योगी योगादिकं नास्ति सदा सर्वं सदा न च
translit: buddhyā niścinute nāsti cittena jñāyate nahi | yogī yogādikaṃ nāsti sadā sarvaṃ sadā na ca
en: determined by intellect, does not exist; known by mind, not at all. There is no yogi, no yoga and the like; always all, always not.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: determined by intellect, does not exist; known by mind, not at all. There is no yogi, no yoga and the like; always all, always not.।

sanskrit: अहोरात्रादिकं नास्ति स्नानध्यानादिकं नहि । भ्रान्तिरभ्रान्तिर्नास्त्येव नास्त्यनात्मेति निश्चिनु
translit: ahorātrādikaṃ nāsti snānadhyānādikaṃ nahi | bhrāntirabhrāntirnāstyeva nāstyanātmeti niścinu
en: No day and night and the like; no bathing, meditation and the like; neither delusion nor non-delusion exists; be certain there is no non-Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No day and night and the like; no bathing, ध्यान/उपासना and the like; neither delusion nor non-delusion exists; be certain there is no non-Self.।

sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रं पुराणं च कार्यं कारणमीश्वरः । लोको भूतं जनस्त्वैक्यं सर्वं मिथ्या न संशयः
translit: vedaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca kāryaṃ kāraṇamīśvaraḥ | loko bhūtaṃ janastvaikyaṃ sarvaṃ mithyā na saṃśayaḥ
en: Veda, scripture, Purana, effect, cause, Lord, world, beings, people, unity — all is false; no doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Veda, scripture, Purana, effect, cause, Lord, world, beings, people, unity — all is false; no doubt.।

sanskrit: बन्धो मोक्षः सुखं दुःखं ध्यानं चित्तं सुरासुराः । गौणं मुख्यं परं चान्यत्सर्वं मिथ्या न संशयः
translit: bandho mokṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dhyānaṃ cittaṃ surāsurāḥ | gauṇaṃ mukhyaṃ paraṃ cānyatsarvaṃ mithyā na saṃśayaḥ
en: Bondage, liberation, pleasure, pain, meditation, mind, gods and demons, secondary, primary, supreme and other — all is false; no doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Bondage, मोक्ष, pleasure, pain, ध्यान/उपासना, mind, gods and demons, secondary, primary, supreme and other — all is false; no doubt.।

sanskrit: वाचा वदति यत्किञ्चित्सङ्कल्पैः कल्प्यते च यत् । मनसा चिन्त्यते यद्यत्सर्वं मिथ्या न संशयः
translit: vācā vadati yatkiñcitsaṅkalpaiḥ kalpyate ca yat | manasā cintyate yadyatsarvaṃ mithyā na saṃśayaḥ
en: Whatever is said by speech, whatever is imagined by intentions, whatever is thought by mind — all is false; no doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is कहा by speech, whatever is imagined by intentions, whatever is thought by mind — all is false; no doubt.।

sanskrit: बुद्ध्या निश्चीयते किञ्चिच्चित्ते निश्चीयते क्वचित् । शास्त्रैः प्रपञ्च्यते यद्यन्नेत्रेणैव निरीक्ष्यते
translit: buddhyā niścīyate kiñciccitte niścīyate kvacit | śāstraiḥ prapañcyate yadyannetreṇaiva nirīkṣyate
en: Whatever is determined by intellect, determined anywhere in the mind, extended by scriptures, seen by the eye,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is determined by intellect, determined anywhere in मन, extended by scriptures, seen by the eye,।

sanskrit: श्रोत्राभ्यां श्रूयते यद्यदन्यत्सद्भावमेव च । नेत्रं श्रोत्रं गात्रमेव मिथ्येति च सुनिश्चितम्
translit: śrotrābhyāṃ śrūyate yadyadanyatsadbhāvameva ca | netraṃ śrotraṃ gātrameva mithyeti ca suniścitam
en: whatever is heard by the ears, and any other existing thing — eye, ear, body are firmly determined as false.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is heard by the ears, and any other existing thing — eye, ear, body are firmly determined as false.।

sanskrit: इदमित्येव निर्दिष्टमयमित्येव कल्प्यते । त्वमहं तदिदं सोऽहमन्यत्सद्भावमेव च
translit: idamityeva nirdiṣṭamayamityeva kalpyate | tvamahaṃ tadidaṃ so'hamanyatsadbhāvameva ca
en: "This" is what is pointed to; "this" is what is imagined; you, I, that, this, he, and any other existing thing —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This" is what is pointed to; "this" is what is imagined; you, I, that, this, he, and any other existing thing —।

sanskrit: यद्यत्सम्भाव्यते लोके सर्वसङ्कल्पसम्भ्रमः । सर्वाध्यासं सर्वगोप्यं सर्वभोगप्रभेदकम्
translit: yadyatsambhāvyate loke sarvasaṅkalpasambhramaḥ | sarvādhyāsaṃ sarvagopyaṃ sarvabhogaprabhedakam
en: whatever is imagined in the world, the confusion of all intention, all superimposition, all secrets, all differences of enjoyment,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is imagined in the world, the confusion of all intention, all superimposition, all secrets, all differences of enjoyment,।

sanskrit: सर्वदोषप्रभेदाच्च नास्त्यनात्मेति निश्चिनु । मदीयं च त्वदीयं च ममेति च तवेति च
translit: sarvadoṣaprabhedācca nāstyanātmeti niścinu | madīyaṃ ca tvadīyaṃ ca mameti ca taveti ca
en: and from the distinction of all faults, be certain there is no non-Self. Mine and yours, "of me" and "of you,"
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: and from the distinction of all faults, be certain there is no non-Self. Mine and yours, "of me" and "of you,।

sanskrit: मह्यं तुभ्यं मयेत्यादि तत्सर्वं वितथं भवेत् । रक्षको विष्णुरित्यादि ब्रह्मा सृष्टेस्तु कारणम्
translit: mahyaṃ tubhyaṃ mayetyādi tatsarvaṃ vitathaṃ bhavet | rakṣako viṣṇurityādi brahmā sṛṣṭestu kāraṇam
en: "for me," "for you," "by me" and the like — all that is false. Vishnu is the protector, Brahma is the cause of creation,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: for me," "for you," "by me" and the like — all that is false. Vishnu is the protector, Brahma is the cause of creation,।

sanskrit: संहारे रुद्र इत्येवं सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु । स्नानं जपस्तपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवपूजनम्
translit: saṃhāre rudra ityevaṃ sarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu | snānaṃ japastapo homaḥ svādhyāyo devapūjanam
en: Rudra of dissolution — be certain all this is false. Bathing, repetition, austerity, oblation, self-study, worship of gods,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Rudra of dissolution — be certain all this is false. Bathing, repetition, तपस्या, oblation, self-study, worship of gods,।

sanskrit: मन्त्रं तन्त्रं च सत्सङ्गो गुणदोषविजृम्भणम् । अन्तःकरणसद्भाव अविद्याश्च सम्भवः
translit: mantraṃ tantraṃ ca satsaṅgo guṇadoṣavijṛmbhaṇam | antaḥkaraṇasadbhāva avidyāśca sambhavaḥ
en: mantra, tantra, company of the good, the display of qualities and faults, the existence of the inner instrument and the rise of ignorance,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: mantra, tantra, company of the good, the display of qualities and faults, the existence of the inner instrument and the rise of अविद्या,।

sanskrit: अनेककोटिब्रह्माण्डं सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु । सर्वदेशिकवाक्योक्तिर्येन केनापि निश्चितम्
translit: anekakoṭibrahmāṇḍaṃ sarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu | sarvadeśikavākyoktiryena kenāpi niścitam
en: many crores of universes — be certain all is false. The utterances of all teachers, whatever has been determined by anyone,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: many crores of universes — be certain all is false. The utterances of all teachers, whatever has been determined by anyone,।

sanskrit: दृश्यते जगति यद्यद्यद्यज्जगति वीक्ष्यते । वर्तते जगति यद्यत्सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु
translit: dṛśyate jagati yadyadyadyajjagati vīkṣyate | vartate jagati yadyatsarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu
en: whatever is seen in the world, whatever is looked at in the world, whatever exists in the world — be certain all is false.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is seen in the world, whatever is looked at in the world, whatever exists in the world — be certain all is false.।

sanskrit: येन केनाक्षरेणोक्तं येन केन विनिश्चितम् । येन केनापि गदितं येन केनापि मोदितम्
translit: yena kenākṣareṇoktaṃ yena kena viniścitam | yena kenāpi gaditaṃ yena kenāpi moditam
en: Whatever is said by any letter, determined by anyone, spoken by anyone, rejoiced in by anyone,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is कहा by any letter, determined by anyone, spoken by anyone, rejoiced in by anyone,।

sanskrit: येन केनापि यद्दत्तं येन केनापि यत्कृतम् । यत्र यत्र शुभं कर्म यत्र यत्र च दुष्कृतम्
translit: yena kenāpi yaddattaṃ yena kenāpi yatkṛtam | yatra yatra śubhaṃ karma yatra yatra ca duṣkṛtam
en: whatever given by anyone, done by anyone, wherever good action, wherever evil action,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever given by anyone, done by anyone, wherever good action, wherever evil action,।

sanskrit: यद्यत्करोषि सत्येन सर्वं मिथ्येति निश्चिनु । त्वमेव परमात्मासि त्वमेव परमो गुरुः
translit: yadyatkaroṣi satyena sarvaṃ mithyeti niścinu | tvameva paramātmāsi tvameva paramo guruḥ
en: whatever you do with truth — be certain all is false. You alone are the Supreme Self; you alone are the supreme teacher.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever you do with truth — be certain all is false. You alone are परमात्मा; you alone are the supreme teacher.।

sanskrit: त्वमेवाकाशरूपोऽसि साक्षिहीनोऽसि सर्वदा । त्वमेव सर्वभावोऽसि त्वं ब्रह्मासि न संशयः
translit: tvamevākāśarūpo'si sākṣihīno'si sarvadā | tvameva sarvabhāvo'si tvaṃ brahmāsi na saṃśayaḥ
en: You alone are of the form of space; you are ever without witness; you alone are all being; you are Brahman; no doubt.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You alone are of the form of space; you are ever without witness; you alone are all being; you are परब्रह्म; no doubt.।

sanskrit: कालहीनोऽसि कालोऽसि सदा ब्रह्मासि चिद्घनः । सर्वतः स्वस्वरूपोऽसि चैतन्यघनवानसि
translit: kālahīno'si kālo'si sadā brahmāsi cidghanaḥ | sarvataḥ svasvarūpo'si caitanyaghanavānasi
en: You are free of time, you are time; you are always Brahman, a mass of consciousness; you are of your own nature everywhere; you are a mass of consciousness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are free of time, you are time; you are always परब्रह्म, a mass of चैतन्य; you are of your own nature everywhere; you are a mass of चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: सत्योऽसि सिद्धोऽसि सनातनोऽसि मुक्तोऽसि मोक्षोऽसि मुदामृतोऽसि । देवोऽसि शान्तोऽसि निरामयोऽसि ब्रह्मासि पूर्णोऽसि परात्परोऽसि
translit: satyo'si siddho'si sanātano'si mukto'si mokṣo'si mudāmṛto'si | devo'si śānto'si nirāmayo'si brahmāsi pūrṇo'si parātparo'si
en: You are truth, you are perfected, you are eternal, you are free, you are liberation, you are joy and nectar; you are god, you are peaceful, you are without disease; you are Brahman, you are full, you are higher than the highest.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are truth, you are perfected, you are eternal, you are free, you are मोक्ष, you are joy and nectar; you are god, you are peaceful, you are without disease; you are परब्रह्म, you are full, you are higher than the highest.।

sanskrit: समोऽसि सच्चापि सनातनोऽसि सत्यादिवाक्यैः प्रतिबोधितोऽसि । सर्वाङ्गहीनोऽसि सदा स्थितोऽसि ब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्रादिविभावितोऽसि
translit: samo'si saccāpi sanātano'si satyādivākyaiḥ pratibodhito'si | sarvāṅgahīno'si sadā sthito'si brahmendrarudrādivibhāvito'si
en: You are even, you are being, you are eternal, you are awakened by sayings like "truth"; you are devoid of all limbs, you are ever established; you are contemplated by Brahma, Indra, Rudra and the rest.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are even, you are being, you are eternal, you are awakened by sayings like "truth"; you are devoid of all limbs, you are ever established; you are contemplated by Brahma, Indra, Rudra and the rest.।

sanskrit: सर्वप्रपञ्चभ्रमवर्जितोऽसि सर्वेषु भूतेषु च भासितोऽसि । सर्वत्र सङ्कल्पविवर्जितोऽसि सर्वागमान्तार्थविभावितोऽसि
translit: sarvaprapañcabhramavarjito'si sarveṣu bhūteṣu ca bhāsito'si | sarvatra saṅkalpavivarjito'si sarvāgamāntārthavibhāvito'si
en: You are free of the delusion of all the world; you shine in all beings; you are free of intention everywhere; you are contemplated as the final meaning of all scriptures.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are free of the delusion of all the world; you shine in all beings; you are free of intention everywhere; you are contemplated as the final meaning of all scriptures.।

sanskrit: सर्वत्र सन्तोषसुखासनोऽसि सर्वत्र गत्यादिविवर्जितोऽसि । सर्वत्र लक्ष्यादिविवर्जितोऽसि ध्यातोऽसि विष्ण्वादिसुरैरजस्रम्
translit: sarvatra santoṣasukhāsano'si sarvatra gatyādivivarjito'si | sarvatra lakṣyādivivarjito'si dhyāto'si viṣṇvādisurairajasram
en: You are everywhere at ease in contentment; you are everywhere free of going and the like; you are everywhere free of aim and the like; you are constantly meditated on by Vishnu and the other gods.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are everywhere at ease in contentment; you are everywhere free of going and the like; you are everywhere free of aim and the like; you are constantly meditated on by Vishnu and the other gods.।

sanskrit: चिदाकारस्वरूपोऽसि चिन्मात्रोऽसि निरङ्कुशः । आत्मन्येव स्थितोऽसि त्वं सर्वशून्योऽसि निर्गुणः
translit: cidākārasvarūpo'si cinmātro'si niraṅkuśaḥ | ātmanyeva sthito'si tvaṃ sarvaśūnyo'si nirguṇaḥ
en: You are of the nature of the form of consciousness; you are mere consciousness, unchecked; you abide in the Self alone; you are void of all, attributeless.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are of the nature of the form of चैतन्य; you are mere चैतन्य, unchecked; you abide in आत्मा alone; you are void of all, attributeless.।

sanskrit: आनन्दोऽसि परोऽसि त्वमेक एवाद्वितीयकः । चिद्घनानन्दरूपोऽसि परिपूर्णस्वरूपकः
translit: ānando'si paro'si tvameka evādvitīyakaḥ | cidghanānandarūpo'si paripūrṇasvarūpakaḥ
en: You are bliss, you are the supreme; you are one alone without a second; you are of the form of a mass of consciousness-bliss; you are of fully complete nature.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are bliss, you are the supreme; you are one alone without a second; you are of the form of a mass of चैतन्य-bliss; you are of fully complete nature.।

sanskrit: सदसि त्वमसि ज्ञोऽसि सोऽसि जानासि वीक्षसि । सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽसि वासुदेवोऽसि वै प्रभुः
translit: sadasi tvamasi jño'si so'si jānāsi vīkṣasi | saccidānandarūpo'si vāsudevo'si vai prabhuḥ
en: You are being, you are "thou," you are the knower, you are "he"; you know, you see; you are of the form of being-consciousness-bliss; you are Vasudeva, the lord.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are being, you are "thou," you are the knower, you are "he"; you know, you see; you are of the form of being-चैतन्य-bliss; you are Vasudeva, the lord.।

sanskrit: अमृतोऽसि विभुश्चासि चञ्चलो ह्यचलो ह्यसि । सर्वोऽसि सर्वहीनोऽसि शान्ताशान्तविवर्जितः
translit: amṛto'si vibhuścāsi cañcalo hyacalo hyasi | sarvo'si sarvahīno'si śāntāśāntavivarjitaḥ
en: You are immortal, you are all-pervading; you are both moving and unmoving; you are all, you are devoid of all; free of peaceful and unpeaceful.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are immortal, you are all-pervading; you are both moving and unmoving; you are all, you are devoid of all; free of peaceful and unpeaceful.।

sanskrit: सत्तामात्रप्रकाशोऽसि सत्तासामान्यको ह्यसि । नित्यसिद्धिस्वरूपोऽसि सर्वसिद्धिविवर्जितः
translit: sattāmātraprakāśo'si sattāsāmānyako hyasi | nityasiddhisvarūpo'si sarvasiddhivivarjitaḥ
en: You are the light of mere being; you are common being; you are of the nature of eternal accomplishment; free of all accomplishments.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are the light of mere being; you are common being; you are of the nature of eternal accomplishment; free of all accomplishments.।

sanskrit: ईषन्मात्रविशून्योऽसि अणुमात्रविवर्जितः । अस्तित्ववर्जितोऽसि त्वं नास्तित्वादिविवर्जितः
translit: īṣanmātraviśūnyo'si aṇumātravivarjitaḥ | astitvavarjito'si tvaṃ nāstitvādivivarjitaḥ
en: You are void of even a trace; free of even an atom; you are free of existence; free of non-existence and the like.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are void of even a trace; free of even an atom; you are free of existence; free of non-existence and the like.।

sanskrit: लक्ष्यलक्षणहीनोऽसि निर्विकारो निरामयः । सर्वनादान्तरोऽसि त्वं कलाकाष्ठाविवर्जितः
translit: lakṣyalakṣaṇahīno'si nirvikāro nirāmayaḥ | sarvanādāntaro'si tvaṃ kalākāṣṭhāvivarjitaḥ
en: You are devoid of aim and mark, changeless, free of disease; you are inside all nada; free of parts and moments.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are devoid of aim and mark, changeless, free of disease; you are inside all nada; free of parts and moments.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशहीनोऽसि स्वस्वरूपं प्रपश्यसि । स्वस्वरूपावशेषोऽसि स्वानन्दाब्धौ निमज्जसि
translit: brahmaviṣṇvīśahīno'si svasvarūpaṃ prapaśyasi | svasvarūpāvaśeṣo'si svānandābdhau nimajjasi
en: You are devoid of Brahma, Vishnu, Ishvara; you behold your own nature; you remain as your own nature; you plunge into the ocean of your own bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are devoid of Brahma, Vishnu, Ishvara; you behold your own nature; you remain as your own nature; you plunge into the ocean of your own bliss.।

sanskrit: स्वात्मराज्ये स्वमेवासि स्वयम्भावविवर्जितः । शिष्टपूर्णस्वरूपोऽसि स्वस्मात्किञ्चिन्न पश्यसि
translit: svātmarājye svamevāsi svayambhāvavivarjitaḥ | śiṣṭapūrṇasvarūpo'si svasmātkiñcinna paśyasi
en: In the kingdom of your own Self you are only yourself, free of self-being; you are of the nature of the remaining fullness; you see nothing apart from yourself.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: In the kingdom of your own Self you are only yourself, free of self-being; you are of the nature of the remaining fullness; you see nothing apart from yourself.।

sanskrit: स्वस्वरूपान्न चलसि स्वस्वरूपेण जृम्भसि । स्वस्वरूपादनन्योऽसि ह्यहमेवासि निश्चिनु
translit: svasvarūpānna calasi svasvarūpeṇa jṛmbhasi | svasvarūpādananyo'si hyahamevāsi niścinu
en: You do not move from your own nature; you expand by your own nature; you are not other than your own nature; be certain that you are I alone.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You do not move from your own nature; you expand by your own nature; you are not other than your own nature; be certain that you are I alone.।

sanskrit: इदं प्रपञ्चं यत्किञ्चिद्यद्यज्जगति विद्यते । दृश्यरूपं च दृग्रूपं सर्वं शशविषाणवत्
translit: idaṃ prapañcaṃ yatkiñcidyadyajjagati vidyate | dṛśyarūpaṃ ca dṛgrūpaṃ sarvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat
en: Whatever this world is, whatever exists in the world, of the form of the seen and the form of seeing, all is like a hare's horn.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever this world is, whatever exists in the world, of the form of the seen and the form of seeing, all is like a hare's horn.।

sanskrit: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च । अहङ्कारश्च तेजश्च लोकं भुवनमण्डलम्
translit: bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca | ahaṅkāraśca tejaśca lokaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍalam
en: Earth, water, fire, wind, space, mind and intellect, ego, light, the world and the orb of the worlds,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Earth, water, fire, wind, space, mind and intellect, ego, light, the world and the orb of the worlds,।

sanskrit: नाशो जन्म च सत्यं च पुण्यपापजयादिकम् । रागः कामः क्रोधलोभौ ध्यानं ध्येयं गुणं परम्
translit: nāśo janma ca satyaṃ ca puṇyapāpajayādikam | rāgaḥ kāmaḥ krodhalobhau dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ guṇaṃ param
en: destruction and birth, truth, merit, sin, victory and the like, passion, desire, anger, greed, meditation, the object of meditation, the highest quality,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: destruction and birth, truth, merit, sin, victory and the like, passion, desire, anger, greed, ध्यान/उपासना, the object of ध्यान/उपासना, the highest quality,।

sanskrit: गुरुशिष्योपदेशादिरादिरन्तं शमं शुभम् । भूतं भव्यं वर्तमानं लक्ष्यं लक्षणमद्वयम्
translit: guruśiṣyopadeśādirādirantaṃ śamaṃ śubham | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vartamānaṃ lakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇamadvayam
en: teaching of teacher and disciple and the like, beginning, end, peace, auspiciousness; past, future, present, aim, mark, non-duality;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: teaching of teacher and disciple and the like, beginning, end, peace, auspiciousness; past, future, present, aim, mark, non-duality;।

sanskrit: शमो विचारः सन्तोषो भोक्तृभोज्यादिरूपकम् । यमाद्यष्टाङ्गयोगं च गमनागमनात्मकम्
translit: śamo vicāraḥ santoṣo bhoktṛbhojyādirūpakam | yamādyaṣṭāṅgayogaṃ ca gamanāgamanātmakam
en: peace, inquiry, contentment, forms such as enjoyer and enjoyed, the eight-limbed yoga beginning with Yama, of the nature of going and coming,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: peace, inquiry, contentment, forms such as enjoyer and enjoyed, the eight-limbed yoga beginning with Yama, of the nature of going and coming,।

sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तरङ्गं च ग्राह्यं त्याज्यं हरिः शिवः । इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव अवस्थात्रितयं तथा
translit: ādimadhyāntaraṅgaṃ ca grāhyaṃ tyājyaṃ hariḥ śivaḥ | indriyāṇi manaścaiva avasthātritayaṃ tathā
en: beginning, middle and inner limb, the graspable, the abandonable, Hari, Shiva, the senses and mind, and the three states likewise,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: beginning, middle and inner limb, the graspable, the abandonable, Hari, Shiva, इन्द्रियाँ and mind, and the three states likewise,।

sanskrit: चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वं च साधनानां चतुष्टयम् । सजातीयं विजातीयं लोका भूरादयः क्रमात्
translit: caturviṃśatitattvaṃ ca sādhanānāṃ catuṣṭayam | sajātīyaṃ vijātīyaṃ lokā bhūrādayaḥ kramāt
en: the twenty-four principles, the fourfold means, same-kind and different-kind, the worlds beginning with Bhu in order,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the twenty-four principles, the fourfold means, same-kind and different-kind, the worlds beginning with Bhu in order,।

sanskrit: सर्ववर्णाश्रमाचारं मन्त्रतन्त्रादिसङ्ग्रहम् । विद्याविद्यादिरूपं च सर्ववेदं जडाजडम्
translit: sarvavarṇāśramācāraṃ mantratantrādisaṅgraham | vidyāvidyādirūpaṃ ca sarvavedaṃ jaḍājaḍam
en: the conduct of all castes and stages of life, the collections of mantras, tantras and the like, the forms of knowledge and ignorance, all the Vedas, the dull and the non-dull,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the conduct of all castes and stages of life, the collections of mantras, tantras and the like, the forms of ज्ञान and अविद्या, all the Vedas, the dull and the non-dull,।

sanskrit: बन्धमोक्षविभागं च ज्ञानविज्ञानरूपकम् । बोधाबोधस्वरूपं वा द्वैताद्वैतादिभाषणम्
translit: bandhamokṣavibhāgaṃ ca jñānavijñānarūpakam | bodhābodhasvarūpaṃ vā dvaitādvaitādibhāṣaṇam
en: the division of bondage and liberation, the forms of knowledge and wisdom, the nature of awakening and non-awakening, the talk of duality and non-duality,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the division of bondage and मोक्ष, the forms of ज्ञान and wisdom, the nature of awakening and non-awakening, the talk of duality and non-duality,।

sanskrit: सर्ववेदान्तसिद्धान्तं सर्वशास्त्रार्थनिर्णयम् । अनेकजीवसद्भावमेकजीवादिनिर्णयम्
translit: sarvavedāntasiddhāntaṃ sarvaśāstrārthanirṇayam | anekajīvasadbhāvamekajīvādinirṇayam
en: the conclusion of all Vedanta, the determination of the meaning of all scriptures, the existence of many individuals, the decision of one individual and the like,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the conclusion of all Vedanta, the determination of the meaning of all scriptures, the existence of many individuals, the decision of one individual and the like,।

sanskrit: यद्यद्ध्यायति चित्तेन यद्यत्सङ्कल्पते क्वचित् । बुद्ध्या निश्चीयते यद्यद्गुरुणा संशृणोति यत्
translit: yadyaddhyāyati cittena yadyatsaṅkalpate kvacit | buddhyā niścīyate yadyadguruṇā saṃśṛṇoti yat
en: whatever one meditates on with the mind, whatever one intends anywhere, whatever the intellect determines, whatever one hears from the teacher,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever one meditates on with मन, whatever one intends anywhere, whatever बुद्धि determines, whatever one hears from गुरुदेव,।

sanskrit: यद्यद्वाचा व्याकरोति यद्यदाचार्यभाषणम् । यद्यत्स्वरेन्द्रियैर्भाव्यं यद्यन्मीमांसते पृथक्
translit: yadyadvācā vyākaroti yadyadācāryabhāṣaṇam | yadyatsvarendriyairbhāvyaṃ yadyanmīmāṃsate pṛthak
en: whatever one explains by speech, whatever the teacher says, whatever is contemplated by the senses, whatever is considered separately,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever one explains by speech, whatever गुरुदेव says, whatever is contemplated by इन्द्रियाँ, whatever is considered separately,।

sanskrit: यद्यन्न्यायेन निर्णीतं महद्भिर्वेदपारगैः । शिवः क्षरति लोकान्वै विष्णुः पाति जगत्त्रयम्
translit: yadyannyāyena nirṇītaṃ mahadbhirvedapāragaiḥ | śivaḥ kṣarati lokānvai viṣṇuḥ pāti jagattrayam
en: whatever is decided by reasoning by the great who have mastered the Vedas — Shiva dissolves the worlds; Vishnu protects the three worlds;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is decided by reasoning by the great who have mastered the Vedas — Shiva dissolves the worlds; Vishnu protects the three worlds;।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मा सृजति लोकान्वै एवमादिक्रियादिकम् । यद्यदस्ति पुराणेषु यद्यद्वेदेषु निर्णयम्
translit: brahmā sṛjati lokānvai evamādikriyādikam | yadyadasti purāṇeṣu yadyadvedeṣu nirṇayam
en: Brahma creates the worlds, and so on with actions like these; whatever is in the Puranas, whatever is determined in the Vedas,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Brahma creates the worlds, and so on with actions like these; whatever is in the Puranas, whatever is determined in the Vedas,।

sanskrit: सर्वोपनिषदां भावं सर्वं शशविषाणवत् । देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पं तदन्तःकरणं स्मृतम्
translit: sarvopaniṣadāṃ bhāvaṃ sarvaṃ śaśaviṣāṇavat | deho'hamiti saṅkalpaṃ tadantaḥkaraṇaṃ smṛtam
en: the sense of all Upanishads — all is like a hare's horn. The intention "I am the body" is called the inner instrument.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the sense of all Upanishads — all is like a hare's horn. The intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है the inner instrument.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो महत्संसार उच्यते । देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पस्तद्बन्धमिति चोच्यते
translit: deho'hamiti saṅkalpo mahatsaṃsāra ucyate | deho'hamiti saṅkalpastadbandhamiti cocyate
en: The intention "I am the body" is called the great world; the intention "I am the body" is also called bondage.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है the great world; the intention "I am शरीर" is also called bondage.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पस्तद्दुःखमिति चोच्यते । देहोऽहमिति यद्भानं तदेव नरकं स्मृतम्
translit: deho'hamiti saṅkalpastadduḥkhamiti cocyate | deho'hamiti yadbhānaṃ tadeva narakaṃ smṛtam
en: The intention "I am the body" is called sorrow; the appearance "I am the body" is remembered as hell.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है sorrow; the appearance "I am शरीर" is remembered as hell.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो जगत्सर्वमितीर्यते । देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो हृदयग्रन्थिरीरितिः
translit: deho'hamiti saṅkalpo jagatsarvamitīryate | deho'hamiti saṅkalpo hṛdayagranthirīritiḥ
en: The intention "I am the body" is declared the whole world; the intention "I am the body" is called the knot of the heart.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" is declared the whole world; the intention "I am शरीर" कहलाता है the knot of हृदय-गुहा.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं तदेवाज्ञानमुच्यते । देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं तदसद्भावमेव च
translit: deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ tadevājñānamucyate | deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ tadasadbhāvameva ca
en: The knowledge "I am the body" is called ignorance; the knowledge "I am the body" is also non-being.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The ज्ञान "I am शरीर" कहलाता है अविद्या; the ज्ञान "I am शरीर" is also non-being.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति या बुद्धिः सा चाविद्येति भण्यते । देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं तदेव द्वैतमुच्यते
translit: deho'hamiti yā buddhiḥ sā cāvidyeti bhaṇyate | deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ tadeva dvaitamucyate
en: The intellect "I am the body" is called nescience; the knowledge "I am the body" is called duality.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: बुद्धि "I am शरीर" कहलाता है nescience; the ज्ञान "I am शरीर" कहलाता है duality.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पः सत्यजीवः स एव हि । देहोऽहमिति यज्ज्ञानं परिच्छिन्नमितीरितम्
translit: deho'hamiti saṅkalpaḥ satyajīvaḥ sa eva hi | deho'hamiti yajjñānaṃ paricchinnamitīritam
en: The intention "I am the body" is the real individual; the knowledge "I am the body" is said to be limited.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" is the real individual; the ज्ञान "I am शरीर" is कहा to be limited.।

sanskrit: देहोऽहमिति सङ्कल्पो महापापमिति स्फुटम् । देहोऽहमिति या बुद्धिस्तृष्णा दोषामयः किल
translit: deho'hamiti saṅkalpo mahāpāpamiti sphuṭam | deho'hamiti yā buddhistṛṣṇā doṣāmayaḥ kila
en: The intention "I am the body" is clearly a great sin; the intellect "I am the body" is craving, a disease of faults.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The intention "I am शरीर" is clearly a great sin; बुद्धि "I am शरीर" is craving, a disease of faults.।

sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिदपि सङ्कल्पस्तापत्रयमितीरितम् । कामं क्रोधं बन्धनं सर्वदुःखं विश्वं दोषं कालनानास्वरूपम् । यत्किञ्चेदं सर्वसङ्कल्पजालं तत्किञ्चेदं मानसं सोम विद्धि
translit: yatkiñcidapi saṅkalpastāpatrayamitīritam | kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bandhanaṃ sarvaduḥkhaṃ viśvaṃ doṣaṃ kālanānāsvarūpam | yatkiñcedaṃ sarvasaṅkalpajālaṃ tatkiñcedaṃ mānasaṃ soma viddhi
en: Any intention at all is said to be the threefold affliction. Desire, anger, bondage, all sorrow, the world, fault, the forms of time in many ways — whatever this net of all intentions is, know it, Soma, as mental.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Any intention at all is कहा to be the threefold affliction. Desire, anger, bondage, all sorrow, the world, fault, the forms of time in many ways — whatever this net of all intentions is, know it, Soma, as mental.।

sanskrit: मन एव जगत्सर्वं मन एव महारिपुः । मन एव हि संसारो मन एव जगत्त्रयम्
translit: mana eva jagatsarvaṃ mana eva mahāripuḥ | mana eva hi saṃsāro mana eva jagattrayam
en: The mind alone is all the world; the mind alone is the great enemy; the mind alone is the world; the mind alone is the three worlds.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is all the world; मन alone is the great enemy; मन alone is the world; मन alone is the three worlds.।

sanskrit: मन एव महद्दुःखं मन एव जरादिकम् । मन एव हि कालश्च मन एव मलं तथा
translit: mana eva mahadduḥkhaṃ mana eva jarādikam | mana eva hi kālaśca mana eva malaṃ tathā
en: The mind alone is great sorrow; the mind alone is old age and the like; the mind alone is time; the mind alone is likewise stain.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is great sorrow; मन alone is old age and the like; मन alone is time; मन alone is likewise stain.।

sanskrit: मन एव हि सङ्कल्पो मन एव हि जीवकः । मन एव हि चित्तं च मनोऽहङ्कार एव च
translit: mana eva hi saṅkalpo mana eva hi jīvakaḥ | mana eva hi cittaṃ ca mano'haṅkāra eva ca
en: The mind alone is intention; the mind alone is the individual; the mind alone is thought, and the mind alone is ego.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is intention; मन alone is the individual; मन alone is thought, and मन alone is ego.।

sanskrit: मन एव महद्बन्धं मनोऽन्तःकरणं च तत् । मन एव हि भूमिश्च मन एव हि तोयकम्
translit: mana eva mahadbandhaṃ mano'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ ca tat | mana eva hi bhūmiśca mana eva hi toyakam
en: The mind alone is great bondage; the mind is the inner instrument; the mind alone is earth; the mind alone is water.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is great bondage; मन is the inner instrument; मन alone is earth; मन alone is water.।

sanskrit: मन एव हि तेजश्च मन एव मरुन्महान् । मन एव हि चाकाशं मन एव हि शब्दकम्
translit: mana eva hi tejaśca mana eva marunmahān | mana eva hi cākāśaṃ mana eva hi śabdakam
en: The mind alone is fire; the mind alone is the great wind; the mind alone is space; the mind alone is sound.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: मन alone is fire; मन alone is the great wind; मन alone is space; मन alone is sound.।

sanskrit: स्पर्शं रूपं रसं गन्धं कोशाः पञ्च मनोभवाः । जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्त्यादि मनोमयरितीरितम्
translit: sparśaṃ rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ kośāḥ pañca manobhavāḥ | jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyādi manomayaritīritam
en: Touch, form, taste, smell, the five sheaths are born of the mind; waking, dream, deep sleep and the rest are said to be made of mind.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Touch, form, taste, smell, the five sheaths are born of मन; waking, dream, deep sleep and the rest are कहा to be made of mind.।

sanskrit: दिक्पाला वसवो रुद्रा आदित्याश्च मनोमयाः । दृश्यं जडं द्वन्द्वजातमज्ञानं मानसं स्मृतम्
translit: dikpālā vasavo rudrā ādityāśca manomayāḥ | dṛśyaṃ jaḍaṃ dvandvajātamajñānaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtam
en: The guardians of the quarters, Vasus, Rudras and Adityas are made of mind; the seen, the dull, the pairs of opposites, ignorance, are held to be mental.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The guardians of the quarters, Vasus, Rudras and Adityas are made of mind; the seen, the dull, the pairs of opposites, अविद्या, are held to be mental.।

sanskrit: सङ्कल्पमेव यत्किञ्चित्तत्तन्नास्तीति निश्चिनु । नास्ति नास्ति जगत्सर्वं गुरुशिष्यादिकं नहीत्युपनिषत्
translit: saṅkalpameva yatkiñcittattannāstīti niścinu | nāsti nāsti jagatsarvaṃ guruśiṣyādikaṃ nahītyupaniṣat
en: Whatever is mere intention — be certain it does not exist. The whole world does not exist, does not exist; teacher and disciple and the rest do not exist — thus the Upanishad.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Whatever is mere intention — be certain it does not exist. The whole world does not exist, does not exist; teacher and disciple and the rest do not exist — thus the Upanishad.।

sanskrit: ऋभुः ॥ सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं विद्धि सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं ततम् । सच्चिदानन्दमद्वैतं सच्चिदानन्दमद्वयम्
translit: ṛbhuḥ || sarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ viddhi sarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ tatam | saccidānandamadvaitaṃ saccidānandamadvayam
en: Ribhu said: Know all as being-consciousness; all is spread out as being-consciousness; being-consciousness-bliss, non-dual; being-consciousness-bliss, without a second.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Ribhu कहा: Know all as being-चैतन्य; all is spread out as being-चैतन्य; being-चैतन्य-bliss, non-dual; being-चैतन्य-bliss, without a second.।

sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमात्रं हि सच्चिदानन्दमन्यकम् । सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽहं सच्चिदानन्दमेव खम्
translit: saccidānandamātraṃ hi saccidānandamanyakam | saccidānandarūpo'haṃ saccidānandameva kham
en: Mere being-consciousness-bliss, being-consciousness-bliss and nothing else; I am of the form of being-consciousness-bliss; space itself is being-consciousness-bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mere being-चैतन्य-bliss, being-चैतन्य-bliss and nothing else; I am of the form of being-चैतन्य-bliss; space itself is being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमेव त्वं सच्चिदानन्दकोऽस्म्यहम् । मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारचित्तसङ्घातका अमी
translit: saccidānandameva tvaṃ saccidānandako'smyaham | manobuddhirahaṅkāracittasaṅghātakā amī
en: You are being-consciousness-bliss alone; I am being-consciousness-bliss; these combinations of mind, intellect, ego and thought —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: You are being-चैतन्य-bliss alone; I am being-चैतन्य-bliss; these combinations of mind, intellect, ego and thought —।

sanskrit: न त्वं नाहं न चान्यद्वा सर्वं ब्रह्मैव केवलम् । न वाक्यं न पदं वेदं नाक्षरं न जडं क्वचित्
translit: na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na cānyadvā sarvaṃ brahmaiva kevalam | na vākyaṃ na padaṃ vedaṃ nākṣaraṃ na jaḍaṃ kvacit
en: not you, not I, nor anything else: all is only Brahman alone. No sentence, no word, no Veda, no syllable, nothing dull anywhere.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: not you, not I, nor anything else: all is only परब्रह्म alone. No sentence, no word, no Veda, no syllable, nothing dull anywhere.।

sanskrit: न मध्यं नादि नान्तं वा न सत्यं न निबन्धजम् । न दुःखं न सुखं भावं न माया प्रकृतिस्तथा
translit: na madhyaṃ nādi nāntaṃ vā na satyaṃ na nibandhajam | na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ bhāvaṃ na māyā prakṛtistathā
en: Neither middle, nor beginning, nor end; neither truth nor born of bondage; neither sorrow nor pleasure nor state; neither illusion nor nature.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Neither middle, nor beginning, nor end; neither truth nor born of bondage; neither sorrow nor pleasure nor state; neither illusion nor nature.।

sanskrit: न देहं न मुखं घ्राणं न जिह्वा न च तालुनी । न दन्तोष्ठौ ललाटं च निश्वासोच्छ्वास एव च
translit: na dehaṃ na mukhaṃ ghrāṇaṃ na jihvā na ca tālunī | na dantoṣṭhau lalāṭaṃ ca niśvāsocchvāsa eva ca
en: No body, no face, no nose, no tongue, no palate; no teeth, lips, forehead, nor inhalation and exhalation.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No body, no face, no nose, no tongue, no palate; no teeth, lips, forehead, nor inhalation and exhalation.।

sanskrit: न स्वेदमस्थि मांसं च न रक्तं न च मूत्रकम् । न दूरं नान्तिकं नाङ्गं नोदरं न किरीटकम्
translit: na svedamasthi māṃsaṃ ca na raktaṃ na ca mūtrakam | na dūraṃ nāntikaṃ nāṅgaṃ nodaraṃ na kirīṭakam
en: No sweat, bone, flesh, no blood, no urine; no far, no near, no limb, no belly, no crown.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No sweat, bone, flesh, no blood, no urine; no far, no near, no limb, no belly, no crown.।

sanskrit: न हस्तपादचलनं न शास्त्रं न च शासनम् । न वेत्ता वेदनं वेद्यं न जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुप्तयः
translit: na hastapādacalanaṃ na śāstraṃ na ca śāsanam | na vettā vedanaṃ vedyaṃ na jāgratsvapnasuptayaḥ
en: No moving of hands and feet, no scripture, no command; no knower, knowing or known; no waking, dream or sleep.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No moving of hands and feet, no scripture, no command; no knower, knowing or known; no waking, dream or sleep.।

sanskrit: तुर्यातीतं न मे किञ्चित्सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं ततम् । नाध्यात्मिकं नाधिभूतं नाधिदैवं न मायिकम्
translit: turyātītaṃ na me kiñcitsarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ tatam | nādhyātmikaṃ nādhibhūtaṃ nādhidaivaṃ na māyikam
en: Nothing of mine is beyond the Fourth; all is spread as being-consciousness. Not the individual, not the elemental, not the divine, not the illusory.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Nothing of mine is beyond the Fourth; all is spread as being-चैतन्य. Not the individual, not the elemental, not the divine, not the illusory.।

sanskrit: न विश्वतैजसः प्राज्ञो विराट्सूत्रात्मकेश्वरः । न गमागमचेष्टा च न नष्टं न प्रयोजनम्
translit: na viśvataijasaḥ prājño virāṭsūtrātmakeśvaraḥ | na gamāgamaceṣṭā ca na naṣṭaṃ na prayojanam
en: Not Vishva, Taijasa, Prajna; not Virat, Sutra, Ishvara; no striving of coming and going, no loss, no purpose.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Not Vishva, Taijasa, Prajna; not Virat, Sutra, Ishvara; no striving of coming and going, no loss, no purpose.।

sanskrit: त्याज्यं ग्राह्यं न दूष्यं वा ह्यमेध्यामेध्यकं तथा । न पीनं न कृशं क्लेदं न कालं देशभाषणम्
translit: tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ na dūṣyaṃ vā hyamedhyāmedhyakaṃ tathā | na pīnaṃ na kṛśaṃ kledaṃ na kālaṃ deśabhāṣaṇam
en: No abandonment, no grasping, no fault; no impure or pure; not fat, not thin, not wet; not time, not speech of place.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No abandonment, no grasping, no fault; no impure or pure; not fat, not thin, not wet; not time, not speech of place.।

sanskrit: न सर्वं न भयं द्वैतं न वृक्षतृणपर्वताः । न ध्यानं योगसंसिद्धिर्न ब्रह्मवैश्यक्षत्रकम्
translit: na sarvaṃ na bhayaṃ dvaitaṃ na vṛkṣatṛṇaparvatāḥ | na dhyānaṃ yogasaṃsiddhirna brahmavaiśyakṣatrakam
en: Not all, not fear, not duality; not trees, grasses or mountains; not meditation, nor accomplishment of yoga; not Brahmin, Vaishya or Kshatriya.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Not all, not fear, not duality; not trees, grasses or mountains; not ध्यान/उपासना, nor accomplishment of yoga; not Brahmin, Vaishya or Kshatriya.।

sanskrit: न पक्षी न मृगो नाङ्गी न लोभो मोह एव च । न मदो न च मात्सर्यं कामक्रोधादयस्तथा
translit: na pakṣī na mṛgo nāṅgī na lobho moha eva ca | na mado na ca mātsaryaṃ kāmakrodhādayastathā
en: No bird, no beast, no embodied, no greed, no delusion; no pride, no envy, no desire, anger and the rest.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No bird, no beast, no embodied, no greed, no delusion; no pride, no envy, no desire, anger and the rest.।

sanskrit: न स्त्रीशूद्रबिडालादि भक्ष्यभोज्यादिकं च यत् । न प्रौढहीनो नास्तिक्यं न वार्तावसरोऽति हि
translit: na strīśūdrabiḍālādi bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ ca yat | na prauḍhahīno nāstikyaṃ na vārtāvasaro'ti hi
en: No woman, Shudra, cat and so on; no food or what is eaten; no mature or lacking, no atheism, no occasion for talk.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No woman, Shudra, cat and so on; no food or what is eaten; no mature or lacking, no atheism, no occasion for talk.।

sanskrit: न लौकिको न लोको वा न व्यापारो न मूढता । न भोक्ता भोजनं भोज्यं न पात्रं पानपेयकम्
translit: na laukiko na loko vā na vyāpāro na mūḍhatā | na bhoktā bhojanaṃ bhojyaṃ na pātraṃ pānapeyakam
en: No worldly, no world, no business, no foolishness; no enjoyer, meal or food; no vessel, drink or drinkable.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No worldly, no world, no business, no foolishness; no enjoyer, meal or food; no vessel, drink or drinkable.।

sanskrit: न शत्रुमित्रपुत्रादिर्न माता न पिता स्वसा । न जन्म न मृतिर्वृद्धिर्न देहोऽहमिति भ्रमः
translit: na śatrumitraputrādirna mātā na pitā svasā | na janma na mṛtirvṛddhirna deho'hamiti bhramaḥ
en: No enemy, friend, son and so on; no mother, father, sister; no birth, death, growth; no delusion "I am the body."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No enemy, friend, son and so on; no mother, father, sister; no birth, death, growth; no delusion "I am शरीर.।

sanskrit: न शून्यं नापि चाशून्यं नान्तःकरणसंसृतिः । न रात्रिर्न दिवा नक्तं न ब्रह्मा न हरिः शिवः
translit: na śūnyaṃ nāpi cāśūnyaṃ nāntaḥkaraṇasaṃsṛtiḥ | na rātrirna divā naktaṃ na brahmā na hariḥ śivaḥ
en: Neither void nor non-void; not the cycle of the inner instrument; no night, no day, no evening; no Brahma, Hari, Shiva.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Neither void nor non-void; not the cycle of the inner instrument; no night, no day, no evening; no Brahma, Hari, Shiva.।

sanskrit: न वारपक्षमासादि वत्सरं न च चञ्चलम् । न ब्रह्मलोको वैकुण्ठो न कैलासो न चान्यकः
translit: na vārapakṣamāsādi vatsaraṃ na ca cañcalam | na brahmaloko vaikuṇṭho na kailāso na cānyakaḥ
en: No weekday, fortnight, month and the like, nor year, nor flickering; no Brahmaloka, Vaikuntha, Kailasa or other.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No weekday, fortnight, month and the like, nor year, nor flickering; no Brahmaloka, Vaikuntha, Kailasa or other.।

sanskrit: न स्वर्गो न च देवेन्द्रो नाग्निलोको न चाग्निकः । न यमो यमलोको वा न लोका लोकपालकाः
translit: na svargo na ca devendro nāgniloko na cāgnikaḥ | na yamo yamaloko vā na lokā lokapālakāḥ
en: No heaven, no Indra; no world of fire, nor Agni; no Yama or world of Yama; no worlds or guardians of worlds.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No heaven, no Indra; no world of fire, nor Agni; no Yama or world of Yama; no worlds or guardians of worlds.।

sanskrit: न भूर्भुवःस्वस्त्रैलोक्यं न पातालं न भूतलम् । नाविद्या न च विद्या च न माया प्रकृतिर्जडा
translit: na bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrailokyaṃ na pātālaṃ na bhūtalam | nāvidyā na ca vidyā ca na māyā prakṛtirjaḍā
en: No Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah, the three worlds; no underworld or earth; neither ignorance nor knowledge; no dull illusion or nature.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah, the three worlds; no underworld or earth; neither अविद्या nor ज्ञान; no dull illusion or nature.।

sanskrit: न स्थिरं क्षणिकं नाशं न गतिर्न च धावनम् । न ध्यातव्यं न मे ध्यानं न मन्त्रो न जपः क्वचित्
translit: na sthiraṃ kṣaṇikaṃ nāśaṃ na gatirna ca dhāvanam | na dhyātavyaṃ na me dhyānaṃ na mantro na japaḥ kvacit
en: No steady, no momentary, no destruction; no going, no running; nothing to be meditated on, no meditation of mine, no mantra, no repetition anywhere.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No steady, no momentary, no destruction; no going, no running; nothing to be meditated on, no ध्यान/उपासना of mine, no mantra, no repetition anywhere.।

sanskrit: न पदार्था न पूजार्हं नाभिषेको न चार्चनम् । न पुष्पं न फलं पत्रं गन्धपुष्पादिधूपकम्
translit: na padārthā na pūjārhaṃ nābhiṣeko na cārcanam | na puṣpaṃ na phalaṃ patraṃ gandhapuṣpādidhūpakam
en: No objects, no one worthy of worship, no anointing, no worship; no flower, fruit, leaf, perfume, incense.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No objects, no one worthy of worship, no anointing, no worship; no flower, fruit, leaf, perfume, incense.।

sanskrit: न स्तोत्रं न नमस्कारो न प्रदक्षिणमण्वपि । न प्रार्थना पृथग्भावो न हविर्नाग्निवन्दनम्
translit: na stotraṃ na namaskāro na pradakṣiṇamaṇvapi | na prārthanā pṛthagbhāvo na havirnāgnivandanam
en: No hymn, no salutation, not even an atom of circumambulation; no prayer, no separateness, no oblation, no salutation to fire.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No hymn, no salutation, not even an atom of circumambulation; no prayer, no separateness, no oblation, no salutation to fire.।

sanskrit: न होमो न च कर्माणि न दुर्वाक्यं सुभाषणम् । न गायत्री न वा सन्धिर्न मनस्यं न दुःस्थितिः
translit: na homo na ca karmāṇi na durvākyaṃ subhāṣaṇam | na gāyatrī na vā sandhirna manasyaṃ na duḥsthitiḥ
en: No oblation, no rites; no ill speech or good speech; no Gayatri, no twilight; no mind-state, no ill-state.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No oblation, no rites; no ill speech or good speech; no Gayatri, no twilight; no mind-state, no ill-state.।

sanskrit: न दुराशा न दुष्टात्मा न चाण्डालो न पौल्कसः । न दुःसहं दुरालापं न किरातो न कैतवम्
translit: na durāśā na duṣṭātmā na cāṇḍālo na paulkasaḥ | na duḥsahaṃ durālāpaṃ na kirāto na kaitavam
en: No bad hope, no wicked soul, no Chandala, no Pulkasa; no unbearable, no ill talk, no Kirata, no deceit.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No bad hope, no wicked soul, no Chandala, no Pulkasa; no unbearable, no ill talk, no Kirata, no deceit.।

sanskrit: न पक्षपातं न पक्षं वा न विभूषणतस्करौ । न च दम्भो दाम्भिको वा न हीनो नाधिको नरः
translit: na pakṣapātaṃ na pakṣaṃ vā na vibhūṣaṇataskarau | na ca dambho dāmbhiko vā na hīno nādhiko naraḥ
en: No partiality or party; no ornament or thief; no pride or proud; no low or high man.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No partiality or party; no ornament or thief; no pride or proud; no low or high man.।

sanskrit: नैकं द्वयं त्रयं तुर्यं न महत्वं न चाल्पता । न पूर्णं न परिच्छिन्नं न काशी न व्रतं तपः
translit: naikaṃ dvayaṃ trayaṃ turyaṃ na mahatvaṃ na cālpatā | na pūrṇaṃ na paricchinnaṃ na kāśī na vrataṃ tapaḥ
en: Not one, two, three, four; no greatness, no smallness; not full, not limited; no Kashi, no vow, no austerity.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Not one, two, three, four; no greatness, no smallness; not full, not limited; no Kashi, no vow, no तपस्या.।

sanskrit: न गोत्रं न कुलं सूत्रं न विभुत्वं न शून्यता । न स्त्री न योषिन्नो वृद्धा न कन्या न वितन्तुता
translit: na gotraṃ na kulaṃ sūtraṃ na vibhutvaṃ na śūnyatā | na strī na yoṣinno vṛddhā na kanyā na vitantutā
en: No lineage, family, thread; no all-pervasiveness, no emptiness; no woman, no girl, no old woman, no maiden, no lack of thread.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No lineage, family, thread; no all-pervasiveness, no emptiness; no woman, no girl, no old woman, no maiden, no lack of thread.।

sanskrit: न सूतकं न जातं वा नान्तर्मुखसुविभ्रमः । न महावाक्यमैक्यं वा नाणिमादिविभूतयः
translit: na sūtakaṃ na jātaṃ vā nāntarmukhasuvibhramaḥ | na mahāvākyamaikyaṃ vā nāṇimādivibhūtayaḥ
en: No impurity of birth or death; no turning inward and illusion; no great saying, no unity, no powers like anima.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No impurity of birth or death; no turning inward and illusion; no great saying, no unity, no powers like anima.।

sanskrit: सर्वचैतन्यमात्रत्वात्सर्वदोषः सदा न हि । सर्वं सन्मात्ररूपत्वात्सच्चिदानन्दमात्रकम्
translit: sarvacaitanyamātratvātsarvadoṣaḥ sadā na hi | sarvaṃ sanmātrarūpatvātsaccidānandamātrakam
en: Because all is mere consciousness, there is never any fault; all is of the form of mere being, mere being-consciousness-bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Because all is mere चैतन्य, there is never any fault; all is of the form of mere being, mere being-चैतन्य-bliss.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मैव सर्वं नान्योऽस्ति तदहं तदहं तथा । तदेवाहं तदेवाहं ब्रह्मैवाहं सनातनम्
translit: brahmaiva sarvaṃ nānyo'sti tadahaṃ tadahaṃ tathā | tadevāhaṃ tadevāhaṃ brahmaivāhaṃ sanātanam
en: Brahman alone is all; there is no other; I am that, I am that likewise; I am that alone, that alone; I am Brahman, the eternal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म alone is all; there is no other; I am that, I am that likewise; I am that alone, that alone; I am परब्रह्म, the eternal.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मैवाहं न संसारी ब्रह्मैवाहं न मे मनः । ब्रह्मैवाहं न मे बुद्धिर्ब्रह्मैवाहं न चेन्द्रियः
translit: brahmaivāhaṃ na saṃsārī brahmaivāhaṃ na me manaḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ na me buddhirbrahmaivāhaṃ na cendriyaḥ
en: I am Brahman, not a worldly being; I am Brahman, not mind; I am Brahman, not intellect; I am Brahman, not senses.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, not a worldly being; I am परब्रह्म, not mind; I am परब्रह्म, not intellect; I am परब्रह्म, not senses.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मैवाहं न देहोऽहं ब्रह्मैवाहं न गोचरः । ब्रह्मैवाहं न जीवोऽहं ब्रह्मैवाहं न भेदभूः
translit: brahmaivāhaṃ na deho'haṃ brahmaivāhaṃ na gocaraḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ na jīvo'haṃ brahmaivāhaṃ na bhedabhūḥ
en: I am Brahman, not body; I am Brahman, not an object; I am Brahman, not an individual; I am Brahman, not a ground of difference.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, not body; I am परब्रह्म, not an object; I am परब्रह्म, not an individual; I am परब्रह्म, not a ground of difference.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मैवाहं जडो नाहमहं ब्रह्म न मे मृतिः । ब्रह्मैवाहं न च प्राणो ब्रह्मैवाहं परात्परः
translit: brahmaivāhaṃ jaḍo nāhamahaṃ brahma na me mṛtiḥ | brahmaivāhaṃ na ca prāṇo brahmaivāhaṃ parātparaḥ
en: I am Brahman, not dull; I am Brahman, I have no death; I am Brahman, not breath; I am Brahman, higher than the highest.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, not dull; I am परब्रह्म, I have no death; I am परब्रह्म, not breath; I am परब्रह्म, higher than the highest.।

sanskrit: इदं ब्रह्म परं ब्रह्म सत्यं ब्रह्म प्रभुर्हि सः । कालो ब्रह्म कला ब्रह्म सुखं ब्रह्म स्वयम्प्रभम्
translit: idaṃ brahma paraṃ brahma satyaṃ brahma prabhurhi saḥ | kālo brahma kalā brahma sukhaṃ brahma svayamprabham
en: This is Brahman, supreme Brahman, true Brahman, the lord; time is Brahman, art is Brahman, happiness is Brahman, self-luminous.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This is परब्रह्म, supreme परब्रह्म, true परब्रह्म, the lord; time is परब्रह्म, art is परब्रह्म, happiness is परब्रह्म, self-luminous.।

sanskrit: एकं ब्रह्म द्वयं ब्रह्म मोहो ब्रह्म शमादिकम् । दोषो ब्रह्म गुणो ब्रह्म दमः शान्तं विभुः प्रभुः
translit: ekaṃ brahma dvayaṃ brahma moho brahma śamādikam | doṣo brahma guṇo brahma damaḥ śāntaṃ vibhuḥ prabhuḥ
en: One is Brahman, two are Brahman; delusion is Brahman, and peace and the rest; fault is Brahman, quality is Brahman; self-control, peace, the all-pervading, the lord.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: One is परब्रह्म, two are परब्रह्म; delusion is परब्रह्म, and peace and the rest; fault is परब्रह्म, quality is परब्रह्म; self-control, peace, the all-pervading, the lord.।

sanskrit: लोको ब्रह्म गुरुर्ब्रह्म शिष्यो ब्रह्म सदाशिवः । पूर्वं ब्रह्म परं ब्रह्म शुद्धं ब्रह्म शुभाशुभम्
translit: loko brahma gururbrahma śiṣyo brahma sadāśivaḥ | pūrvaṃ brahma paraṃ brahma śuddhaṃ brahma śubhāśubham
en: The world is Brahman, the teacher is Brahman, the disciple is Brahman, Sadashiva; the earlier is Brahman, the supreme is Brahman, the pure is Brahman, the good and bad.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The world is परब्रह्म, गुरुदेव is परब्रह्म, the disciple is परब्रह्म, Sadashiva; the earlier is परब्रह्म, the supreme is परब्रह्म, the pure is परब्रह्म, the good and bad.।

sanskrit: जीव एव सदा ब्रह्म सच्चिदानन्दमस्म्यहम् । सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं प्रोक्तं सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं जगत्
translit: jīva eva sadā brahma saccidānandamasmyaham | sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ proktaṃ sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat
en: The individual is always Brahman; I am being-consciousness-bliss. All is said to be made of Brahman; the world is all made of Brahman.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: The individual is always परब्रह्म; I am being-चैतन्य-bliss. All is कहा to be made of परब्रह्म; the world is all made of परब्रह्म.।

sanskrit: स्वयं ब्रह्म न सन्देहः स्वस्मादन्यन्न किञ्चन । सर्वमात्मैव शुद्धात्मा सर्वं चिन्मात्रमद्वयम्
translit: svayaṃ brahma na sandehaḥ svasmādanyanna kiñcana | sarvamātmaiva śuddhātmā sarvaṃ cinmātramadvayam
en: Brahman itself — no doubt; nothing exists apart from oneself; all is the Self, the pure Self; all is non-dual mere consciousness.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म itself — no doubt; nothing exists apart from oneself; all is आत्मा, the pure Self; all is non-dual mere चैतन्य.।

sanskrit: नित्यनिर्मलरूपात्मा ह्यात्मनोऽन्यन्न किञ्चन । अणुमात्रलसद्रूपमणुमात्रमिदं जगत्
translit: nityanirmalarūpātmā hyātmano'nyanna kiñcana | aṇumātralasadrūpamaṇumātramidaṃ jagat
en: The Self of eternal stainless form; nothing is apart from the Self; this world is a shining form only of an atom's size.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: आत्मा of eternal stainless form; nothing is apart from आत्मा; this world is a shining form only of an atom's size.।

sanskrit: अणुमात्रं शरीरं वा ह्यणुमात्रमसत्यकम् । अणुमात्रमचिन्त्यं वा चिन्त्यं वा ह्यणुमात्रकम्
translit: aṇumātraṃ śarīraṃ vā hyaṇumātramasatyakam | aṇumātramacintyaṃ vā cintyaṃ vā hyaṇumātrakam
en: The body is only atom-sized; the unreal is atom-sized; the inconceivable or the conceivable is atom-sized.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: शरीर is only atom-sized; the unreal is atom-sized; the inconceivable or the conceivable is atom-sized.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मैव सर्वं चिन्मात्रं ब्रह्ममात्रं जगत्त्रयम् । आनन्दं परमानन्दमन्यत्किञ्चिन्न किञ्चन
translit: brahmaiva sarvaṃ cinmātraṃ brahmamātraṃ jagattrayam | ānandaṃ paramānandamanyatkiñcinna kiñcana
en: Brahman alone is all, mere consciousness; the three worlds are Brahman only; bliss, supreme bliss — nothing else at all.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म alone is all, mere चैतन्य; the three worlds are परब्रह्म only; bliss, supreme bliss — nothing else at all.।

sanskrit: चैतन्यमात्रमोङ्कारं ब्रह्मैव सकलं स्वयम् । अहमेव जगत्सर्वमहमेव परं पदम्
translit: caitanyamātramoṅkāraṃ brahmaiva sakalaṃ svayam | ahameva jagatsarvamahameva paraṃ padam
en: Mere consciousness is Om; Brahman itself is all; I alone am all the world; I alone am the supreme state.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Mere चैतन्य is Om; परब्रह्म itself is all; I alone am all the world; I alone am the supreme state.।

sanskrit: अहमेव गुणातीत अहमेव परात्परः । अहमेव परं ब्रह्म अहमेव गुरोर्गुरुः
translit: ahameva guṇātīta ahameva parātparaḥ | ahameva paraṃ brahma ahameva gurorguruḥ
en: I alone am beyond the qualities; I alone am higher than the highest; I alone am supreme Brahman; I alone am the teacher of teachers.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am beyond the qualities; I alone am higher than the highest; I alone am supreme परब्रह्म; I alone am गुरुदेव of teachers.।

sanskrit: अहमेवाखिलाधार अहमेव सुखात्सुखम् । आत्मनोऽन्यज्जगन्नास्ति आत्मनोऽन्यत्सुखं न च
translit: ahamevākhilādhāra ahameva sukhātsukham | ātmano'nyajjagannāsti ātmano'nyatsukhaṃ na ca
en: I alone am the support of all; I alone am the happiness of happiness; there is no world apart from the Self; no happiness apart from the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am the support of all; I alone am the happiness of happiness; there is no world apart from आत्मा; no happiness apart from आत्मा.।

sanskrit: आत्मनोऽन्या गतिर्नास्ति सर्वमात्ममयं जगत् । आत्मनोऽन्यन्नहि क्वापि आत्मनोऽन्यत्तृणं नहि
translit: ātmano'nyā gatirnāsti sarvamātmamayaṃ jagat | ātmano'nyannahi kvāpi ātmano'nyattṛṇaṃ nahi
en: There is no goal apart from the Self; the whole world is made of the Self; nothing anywhere is apart from the Self; no grass is apart from the Self.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: There is no goal apart from आत्मा; the whole world is made of आत्मा; nothing anywhere is apart from आत्मा; no grass is apart from आत्मा.।

sanskrit: आत्मनोऽन्यत्तुषं नास्ति सर्वमात्ममयं जगत् । ब्रह्ममात्रमिदं सर्वं ब्रह्ममात्रमसन्न हि
translit: ātmano'nyattuṣaṃ nāsti sarvamātmamayaṃ jagat | brahmamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmamātramasanna hi
en: There is no husk apart from the Self; the whole world is made of the Self; all this is Brahman only; the unreal is not Brahman only.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: There is no husk apart from आत्मा; the whole world is made of आत्मा; all this is परब्रह्म only; the unreal is not परब्रह्म only.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्ममात्रं श्रुतं सर्वं स्वयं ब्रह्मैव केवलम् । ब्रह्ममात्रं वृतं सर्वं ब्रह्ममात्रं रसं सुखम्
translit: brahmamātraṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ svayaṃ brahmaiva kevalam | brahmamātraṃ vṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmamātraṃ rasaṃ sukham
en: All that is heard is Brahman only; oneself is Brahman alone; all that is chosen is Brahman only; the savor, the happiness is Brahman only.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All that is heard is परब्रह्म only; oneself is परब्रह्म alone; all that is chosen is परब्रह्म only; the savor, the happiness is परब्रह्म only.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्ममात्रं चिदाकाशं सच्चिदानन्दमव्ययम् । ब्रह्मणोऽन्यतरन्नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यज्जगन्न च
translit: brahmamātraṃ cidākāśaṃ saccidānandamavyayam | brahmaṇo'nyatarannāsti brahmaṇo'nyajjaganna ca
en: Only Brahman is the space of consciousness, the imperishable being-consciousness-bliss; nothing is other than Brahman; no world is other than Brahman.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Only परब्रह्म is the space of चैतन्य, the imperishable being-चैतन्य-bliss; nothing is other than परब्रह्म; no world is other than परब्रह्म.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मणोऽन्यदह नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यत्फलं नहि । ब्रह्मणोऽन्यत्तृणं नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यत्पदं नहि
translit: brahmaṇo'nyadaha nāsti brahmaṇo'nyatphalaṃ nahi | brahmaṇo'nyattṛṇaṃ nāsti brahmaṇo'nyatpadaṃ nahi
en: Nothing exists apart from Brahman; no fruit is apart from Brahman; no grass is apart from Brahman; no state is apart from Brahman.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Nothing exists apart from परब्रह्म; no fruit is apart from परब्रह्म; no grass is apart from परब्रह्म; no state is apart from परब्रह्म.।

sanskrit: ब्रह्मणोऽन्यद्गुरुर्नास्ति ब्रह्मणोऽन्यमसद्वपुः । ब्रह्मणोऽन्यन्न चाहन्ता त्वत्तेदन्ते नहि क्वचित्
translit: brahmaṇo'nyadgururnāsti brahmaṇo'nyamasadvapuḥ | brahmaṇo'nyanna cāhantā tvattedante nahi kvacit
en: No teacher is apart from Brahman; no body is apart from Brahman, unreal; no egoism is apart from Brahman; "you" and "this" are nowhere.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No teacher is apart from परब्रह्म; no body is apart from परब्रह्म, unreal; no egoism is apart from परब्रह्म; "you" and "this" are nowhere.।

sanskrit: स्वयं ब्रह्मात्मकं विद्धि स्वस्मादन्यन्न किञ्चन । यत्किञ्चिद्दृश्यते लोके यत्किञ्चिद्भाष्यते जनैः
translit: svayaṃ brahmātmakaṃ viddhi svasmādanyanna kiñcana | yatkiñciddṛśyate loke yatkiñcidbhāṣyate janaiḥ
en: Know yourself as Brahman-natured; nothing is apart from oneself. Whatever is seen in the world, whatever is spoken by people,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Know yourself as परब्रह्म-natured; nothing is apart from oneself. Whatever is seen in the world, whatever is spoken by people,।

sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिद्भुज्यते क्वापि तत्सर्वमसदेव हि । कर्तृभेदं क्रियाभेदं गुणभेदं रसादिकम्
translit: yatkiñcidbhujyate kvāpi tatsarvamasadeva hi | kartṛbhedaṃ kriyābhedaṃ guṇabhedaṃ rasādikam
en: whatever is enjoyed anywhere, all that is unreal indeed. The difference of doer, of action, of quality, of taste and the like,
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is enjoyed anywhere, all that is unreal indeed. The difference of doer, of action, of quality, of taste and the like,।

sanskrit: लिङ्गभेदमिदं सर्वमसदेव सदा सुखम् । कालभेदं देशभेदं वस्तुभेदं जयाजयम्
translit: liṅgabhedamidaṃ sarvamasadeva sadā sukham | kālabhedaṃ deśabhedaṃ vastubhedaṃ jayājayam
en: this difference of gender — all this is only unreal; always happiness. Difference of time, of place, of thing, victory and defeat —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: this difference of gender — all this is only unreal; always happiness. Difference of time, of place, of thing, victory and defeat —।

sanskrit: यद्यद्भेदं च तत्सर्वमसदेव हि केवलम् । असदन्तःकरणकमसदेवेन्द्रियादिकम्
translit: yadyadbhedaṃ ca tatsarvamasadeva hi kevalam | asadantaḥkaraṇakamasadevendriyādikam
en: whatever is difference, all that is only unreal. The inner instrument is unreal; the senses and the rest are only unreal;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: whatever is difference, all that is only unreal. The inner instrument is unreal; इन्द्रियाँ and the rest are only unreal;।

sanskrit: असत्प्राणादिकं सर्वं सङ्घातमसदात्मकम् । असत्यं पञ्चकोशाख्यमसत्यं पञ्च देवताः
translit: asatprāṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ saṅghātamasadātmakam | asatyaṃ pañcakośākhyamasatyaṃ pañca devatāḥ
