en: the breath and the rest are all unreal; the aggregate is of unreal nature; the five sheaths so called are unreal; the five deities are unreal;
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the breath and the rest are all unreal; the aggregate is of unreal nature; the five sheaths so called are unreal; the five deities are unreal;।

sanskrit: असत्यं षड्विकारादि असत्यमरिवर्गकम् । असत्यं षडृतुश्चैव असत्यं षड्रसस्तथा
translit: asatyaṃ ṣaḍvikārādi asatyamarivargakam | asatyaṃ ṣaḍṛtuścaiva asatyaṃ ṣaḍrasastathā
en: the six modifications and the like are unreal; the group of six enemies is unreal; the six seasons are unreal; likewise the six tastes are unreal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: the six modifications and the like are unreal; the group of six enemies is unreal; the six seasons are unreal; likewise the six tastes are unreal.।

sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमात्रोऽहमनुत्पन्नमिदं जगत् । आत्मैवाहं परं सत्यं नान्याः संसारदृष्टयः
translit: saccidānandamātro'hamanutpannamidaṃ jagat | ātmaivāhaṃ paraṃ satyaṃ nānyāḥ saṃsāradṛṣṭayaḥ
en: I am mere being-consciousness-bliss; this world has not arisen. I am the Self alone, the supreme truth; no other views of the world.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere being-चैतन्य-bliss; this world has not arisen. I am आत्मा alone, the supreme truth; no other views of the world.।

sanskrit: सत्यमानन्दरूपोऽहं चिद्घनानन्दविग्रहः । अहमेव परानन्द अहमेव परात्परः
translit: satyamānandarūpo'haṃ cidghanānandavigrahaḥ | ahameva parānanda ahameva parātparaḥ
en: I am of the form of true bliss, a body of consciousness and bliss; I alone am supreme bliss; I alone am higher than the highest.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of true bliss, a body of चैतन्य and bliss; I alone am supreme bliss; I alone am higher than the highest.।

sanskrit: ज्ञानाकारमिदं सर्वं ज्ञानानन्दोऽहमद्वयः । सर्वप्रकाशरूपोऽहं सर्वाभावस्वरूपकम्
translit: jñānākāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jñānānando'hamadvayaḥ | sarvaprakāśarūpo'haṃ sarvābhāvasvarūpakam
en: All this is of the form of knowledge; I am knowledge-bliss, non-dual; I am of the form of light of all; I am of the form of the absence of all.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All this is of the form of ज्ञान; I am ज्ञान-bliss, non-dual; I am of the form of light of all; I am of the form of the absence of all.।

sanskrit: अहमेव सदा भामीत्येवं रूपं कुतोऽप्यसत् । त्वमित्येवं परं ब्रह्म चिन्मयानन्दरूपवान्
translit: ahameva sadā bhāmītyevaṃ rūpaṃ kuto'pyasat | tvamityevaṃ paraṃ brahma cinmayānandarūpavān
en: "I alone ever shine" — such a form is unreal from anywhere; "you" — thus supreme Brahman, of the form of consciousness and bliss.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone ever shine" — such a form is unreal from anywhere; "you" — thus supreme परब्रह्म, of the form of चैतन्य and bliss.।

sanskrit: चिदाकारं चिदाकाशं चिदेव परमं सुखम् । आत्मैवाहमसन्नाहं कूटस्थोऽहं गुरुः परः
translit: cidākāraṃ cidākāśaṃ cideva paramaṃ sukham | ātmaivāhamasannāhaṃ kūṭastho'haṃ guruḥ paraḥ
en: Form of consciousness, space of consciousness, consciousness alone is supreme happiness; I am the Self alone, not unreal; I am the immovable witness, the supreme teacher.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Form of चैतन्य, space of चैतन्य, चैतन्य alone is supreme happiness; I am आत्मा alone, not unreal; I am the immovable witness, the supreme teacher.।

sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दमात्रोऽहमनुत्पन्नमिदं जगत् । कालो नास्ति जगन्नास्ति मायाप्रकृतिरेव न
translit: saccidānandamātro'hamanutpannamidaṃ jagat | kālo nāsti jagannāsti māyāprakṛtireva na
en: I am mere being-consciousness-bliss; this world has not arisen. There is no time; there is no world; no illusion or nature at all.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere being-चैतन्य-bliss; this world has not arisen. There is no time; there is no world; no illusion or nature at all.।

sanskrit: अहमेव हरिः साक्षादहमेव सदाशिवः । शुद्धचैतन्यभावोऽहं शुद्धसत्त्वानुभावनः
translit: ahameva hariḥ sākṣādahameva sadāśivaḥ | śuddhacaitanyabhāvo'haṃ śuddhasattvānubhāvanaḥ
en: I alone am Hari in person; I alone am Sadashiva; I am of the state of pure consciousness; of the experience of pure sattva.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I alone am Hari in person; I alone am Sadashiva; I am of the state of pure चैतन्य; of the experience of pure sattva.।

sanskrit: अद्वयानन्दमात्रोऽहं चिद्घनैकरसोऽस्म्यहम् । सर्वं ब्रह्मैव सततं सर्वं ब्रह्मैव केवलम्
translit: advayānandamātro'haṃ cidghanaikaraso'smyaham | sarvaṃ brahmaiva satataṃ sarvaṃ brahmaiva kevalam
en: I am mere non-dual bliss; I am a mass of consciousness of one savor. All is Brahman always; all is Brahman only.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am mere non-dual bliss; I am a mass of चैतन्य of one savor. All is परब्रह्म always; all is परब्रह्म only.।

sanskrit: सर्वं ब्रह्मैव सततं सर्वं ब्रह्मैव चेतनम् । सर्वान्तर्यामिरूपोऽहं सर्वसाक्षित्वलक्षणः
translit: sarvaṃ brahmaiva satataṃ sarvaṃ brahmaiva cetanam | sarvāntaryāmirūpo'haṃ sarvasākṣitvalakṣaṇaḥ
en: All is Brahman always; all is Brahman, conscious. I am of the form of the inner controller of all, marked by being the witness of all.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: All is परब्रह्म always; all is परब्रह्म, conscious. I am of the form of the inner controller of all, marked by being the witness of all.।

sanskrit: परमात्मा परं ज्योतिः परं धाम परा गतिः । सर्ववेदान्तसारोऽहं सर्वशास्त्रसुनिश्चितः
translit: paramātmā paraṃ jyotiḥ paraṃ dhāma parā gatiḥ | sarvavedāntasāro'haṃ sarvaśāstrasuniścitaḥ
en: The Supreme Self, the supreme light, the supreme abode, the supreme goal; I am the essence of all Vedanta, well determined by all scriptures.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परमात्मा, the supreme light, the supreme abode, the supreme goal; I am the essence of all Vedanta, well determined by all scriptures.।

sanskrit: योगानन्दस्वरूपोऽहं मुख्यानन्दमहोदयः । सर्वज्ञानप्रकाशोऽस्मि मुख्यविज्ञानविग्रहः
translit: yogānandasvarūpo'haṃ mukhyānandamahodayaḥ | sarvajñānaprakāśo'smi mukhyavijñānavigrahaḥ
en: I am of the nature of the bliss of yoga, the great rise of principal bliss; I am the light of all knowledge, a body of principal wisdom.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the nature of the bliss of yoga, the great rise of principal bliss; I am the light of all ज्ञान, a body of principal wisdom.।

sanskrit: तुर्यातुर्यप्रकाशोऽस्मि तुर्यातुर्यादिवर्जितः । चिदक्ष्रोऽन् सत्योऽहं वासुदवोऽजररोऽमरः
translit: turyāturyaprakāśo'smi turyāturyādivarjitaḥ | cidakṣro'n satyo'haṃ vāsudavo'jararo'maraḥ
en: I am the light of the Fourth of the Fourth, free of the Fourth of the Fourth and the rest; I am the imperishable consciousness, truth; I am Vasudeva, ageless, deathless.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am the light of the Fourth of the Fourth, free of the Fourth of the Fourth and the rest; I am the imperishable चैतन्य, truth; I am Vasudeva, ageless, deathless.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्म चिदाकाशं नित्यं ब्रह्म निरञ्जनम् । शुद्धं बुद्धं सदामुक्तमनामकमरूपकम्
translit: ahaṃ brahma cidākāśaṃ nityaṃ brahma nirañjanam | śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ sadāmuktamanāmakamarūpakam
en: I am Brahman, the space of consciousness, eternal Brahman, stainless; pure, awake, ever free, nameless, formless.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म, the space of चैतन्य, eternal परब्रह्म, stainless; pure, awake, ever free, nameless, formless.।

sanskrit: सच्चिदानन्दरूपोऽहमनुन्त्पन्नमिदं जगत् । सत्यासत्यं जगन्नास्ति सङ्कल्पकलनादिकम्
translit: saccidānandarūpo'hamanuntpannamidaṃ jagat | satyāsatyaṃ jagannāsti saṅkalpakalanādikam
en: I am of the form of being-consciousness-bliss; this world has not arisen. The true and false world does not exist; nor intention, imagining and the like.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am of the form of being-चैतन्य-bliss; this world has not arisen. The true and false world does not exist; nor intention, imagining and the like.।

sanskrit: नित्यानन्दमयं ब्रह्म केवलं सर्वदा स्वयम् । अनन्तमव्ययं शान्तमेकरूपमनामयम्
translit: nityānandamayaṃ brahma kevalaṃ sarvadā svayam | anantamavyayaṃ śāntamekarūpamanāmayam
en: Brahman is made of eternal bliss, alone, always by itself; infinite, imperishable, peaceful, of one form, free of disease.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: परब्रह्म is made of eternal bliss, alone, always by itself; infinite, imperishable, peaceful, of one form, free of disease.।

sanskrit: मत्तोऽन्यदस्ति चेन्मिथ्या यथा मरुमरीचिका । वन्ध्याकुमारवचने भीतिश्चेदस्ति किञ्चन
translit: matto'nyadasti cenmithyā yathā marumarīcikā | vandhyākumāravacane bhītiścedasti kiñcana
en: If anything exists apart from me, it is false, like a mirage in a desert. If there were any fear from the words of a barren woman's son —
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If anything exists apart from me, it is false, like a mirage in a desert. If there were any fear from the words of a barren woman's son —।

sanskrit: शशशृङ्गेण नागेन्द्रो मृतश्चेज्जगदस्ति तत् । मृगतृष्णाजलं पीत्वा तृप्तश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
translit: śaśaśṛṅgeṇa nāgendro mṛtaścejjagadasti tat | mṛgatṛṣṇājalaṃ pītvā tṛptaścedastvidaṃ jagat
en: If a king of elephants were killed by a hare's horn, then the world would exist. If one drinking mirage-water were satisfied, let this world be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a king of elephants were killed by a hare's horn, then the world would exist. If one drinking mirage-water were satisfied, let this world be.।

sanskrit: नरशृङ्गेण नष्टश्चेत्कश्चिदस्त्विदमेव हि । गन्धर्वनगरे सत्ये जगद्भवति सर्वदा
translit: naraśṛṅgeṇa naṣṭaścetkaścidastvidameva hi | gandharvanagare satye jagadbhavati sarvadā
en: If anyone were destroyed by a man's horn, then this indeed exists. If the city of Gandharvas were true, the world would always be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If anyone were destroyed by a man's horn, then this indeed exists. If the city of Gandharvas were true, the world would always be.।

sanskrit: गगने नीलिमासत्ये जगत्सत्यं भविष्यति । शुक्तिकारजतं सत्यं भूषणं चेज्जगद्भवेत्
translit: gagane nīlimāsatye jagatsatyaṃ bhaviṣyati | śuktikārajataṃ satyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cejjagadbhavet
en: If the blueness of the sky were true, the world would be true. If the silver in a shell were true as ornament, the world would be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the blueness of the sky were true, the world would be true. If the silver in a shell were true as ornament, the world would be.।

sanskrit: रज्जुसर्पेण दष्टश्चेन्नरो भवतु संसृतिः । जातरूपेण बाणेन ज्वालाग्नौ नाशिते जगत्
translit: rajjusarpeṇa daṣṭaścennaro bhavatu saṃsṛtiḥ | jātarūpeṇa bāṇena jvālāgnau nāśite jagat
en: If a man bitten by a rope-snake were to be so, let there be the world; if by a golden arrow the flaming fire were destroyed, the world would be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a man bitten by a rope-snake were to be so, let there be the world; if by a golden arrow the flaming fire were destroyed, the world would be.।

sanskrit: विन्ध्याटव्यां पायसान्नमस्ति चेज्जगदुद्भवः । रम्भास्तम्भेन काष्ठेन पाकसिद्धौ जगद्भवेत्
translit: vindhyāṭavyāṃ pāyasānnamasti cejjagadudbhavaḥ | rambhāstambhena kāṣṭhena pākasiddhau jagadbhavet
en: If there were rice-pudding in the Vindhya forest, the world would arise; if by a plantain trunk as fuel cooking succeeded, the world would be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If there were rice-pudding in the Vindhya forest, the world would arise; if by a plantain trunk as fuel cooking succeeded, the world would be.।

sanskrit: सद्यः कुमारिकरूपैः पाके सिद्धे जगद्भवेत् । चित्रस्थदीपैस्तमसो नाशश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
translit: sadyaḥ kumārikarūpaiḥ pāke siddhe jagadbhavet | citrasthadīpaistamaso nāśaścedastvidaṃ jagat
en: If cooking succeeded by the forms of newly born girls, the world would be; if darkness were destroyed by lamps in a picture, let this world be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If cooking succeeded by the forms of newly born girls, the world would be; if darkness were destroyed by lamps in a picture, let this world be.।

sanskrit: मासात्पूर्वं मृतो मर्त्यो ह्यागतश्चेज्जगद्भवेत् । तक्रं क्षीरस्वरूपं चेत्क्वचिन्नित्यं जगद्भवेत्
translit: māsātpūrvaṃ mṛto martyo hyāgataścejjagadbhavet | takraṃ kṣīrasvarūpaṃ cetkvacinnityaṃ jagadbhavet
en: If a mortal dead a month ago came back, the world would be; if buttermilk were of the nature of milk anywhere, the world would be eternal.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a mortal dead a month ago came back, the world would be; if buttermilk were of the nature of milk anywhere, the world would be eternal.।

sanskrit: गोस्तनादुद्भवं क्षीरं पुनरारोपणे जगत् । भूरजोऽब्धौ समुत्पन्ने जगद्भवतु सर्वदा
translit: gostanādudbhavaṃ kṣīraṃ punarāropaṇe jagat | bhūrajo'bdhau samutpanne jagadbhavatu sarvadā
en: If milk from a cow's udder could be re-planted, the world; if earth-dust arose in the ocean, let the world always be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If milk from a cow's udder could be re-planted, the world; if earth-dust arose in the ocean, let the world always be.।

sanskrit: कूर्मरोम्णा गजे बद्धे जगदस्तु मदोत्कटे । नालस्थतन्तुना मेरुश्चालितश्चेज्जगद्भवेत्
translit: kūrmaromṇā gaje baddhe jagadastu madotkaṭe | nālasthatantunā meruścālitaścejjagadbhavet
en: If an elephant in rut were bound by a tortoise's hair, let there be the world; if Meru were moved by a lotus fiber, the world would be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If an elephant in rut were bound by a tortoise's hair, let there be the world; if Meru were moved by a lotus fiber, the world would be.।

sanskrit: तरङ्गमालया सिन्धुर्बद्धश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत् । अग्नेरधश्चेज्ज्वलनं जगद्भवतु सर्वदा
translit: taraṅgamālayā sindhurbaddhaścedastvidaṃ jagat | agneradhaścejjvalanaṃ jagadbhavatu sarvadā
en: If the ocean were bound by a garland of waves, let this world be; if fire were below fire, let the world always be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the ocean were bound by a garland of waves, let this world be; if fire were below fire, let the world always be.।

sanskrit: ज्वालावह्निः शीतलश्चेदस्तिरूपमिदं जगत् । ज्वालाग्निमण्डले पद्मवृद्धिश्चेज्जगदस्त्विदम्
translit: jvālāvahniḥ śītalaścedastirūpamidaṃ jagat | jvālāgnimaṇḍale padmavṛddhiścejjagadastvidam
en: If a flame were cold, this form of world would exist; if a lotus grew in a circle of flaming fire, let there be the world.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a flame were cold, this form of world would exist; if a lotus grew in a circle of flaming fire, let there be the world.।

sanskrit: महच्छैलेन्द्रनीलं वा सम्भवच्चेदिदं जगत् । मेरुरागत्य पद्माक्षे स्थितश्चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
translit: mahacchailendranīlaṃ vā sambhavaccedidaṃ jagat | merurāgatya padmākṣe sthitaścedastvidaṃ jagat
en: If a great mountain-king of sapphire could arise, this world would be; if Meru came and stood in a lotus bud, let this world be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a great mountain-king of sapphire could arise, this world would be; if Meru came and stood in a lotus bud, let this world be.।

sanskrit: निगिरेच्चेद्भृङ्गसूनुर्मेरुं चलवदस्त्विदम् । मशकेन हते सिंहे जगत्सत्यं तदास्तु ते
translit: nigireccedbhṛṅgasūnurmeruṃ calavadastvidam | maśakena hate siṃhe jagatsatyaṃ tadāstu te
en: If the bee's child swallowed Meru, let this be movable; if a lion were killed by a mosquito, then let the world be true for you.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the bee's child swallowed Meru, let this be movable; if a lion were killed by a mosquito, then let the world be true for you.।

sanskrit: अणुकोटरविस्तीर्णे त्रैलोक्यं चेज्जगद्भवेत् । तृणानलश्च नित्यश्चेत्क्षणिकं तज्जगद्भवेत्
translit: aṇukoṭaravistīrṇe trailokyaṃ cejjagadbhavet | tṛṇānalaśca nityaścetkṣaṇikaṃ tajjagadbhavet
en: If the three worlds fit in the hollow of an atom, the world would be; if a grass fire were eternal, that world would be momentary.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the three worlds fit in the hollow of an atom, the world would be; if a grass fire were eternal, that world would be momentary.।

sanskrit: स्वप्नदृष्टं च यद्वस्तु जागरे चेज्जगद्भवः । नदीवेगो निश्चलश्चेत्केनापीदं भवेज्जगत्
translit: svapnadṛṣṭaṃ ca yadvastu jāgare cejjagadbhavaḥ | nadīvego niścalaścetkenāpīdaṃ bhavejjagat
en: If what is seen in a dream occurred in waking, the world would be; if a river's current were unmoving, by someone this world would be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If what is seen in a dream occurred in waking, the world would be; if a river's current were unmoving, by someone this world would be.।

sanskrit: क्षुधितस्याग्निर्भोज्यश्चेन्निमिषं कल्पितं भवेत् । जात्यन्धै रत्नविषयः सुज्ञातश्चेज्जगत्सदा
translit: kṣudhitasyāgnirbhojyaścennimiṣaṃ kalpitaṃ bhavet | jātyandhai ratnaviṣayaḥ sujñātaścejjagatsadā
en: If fire were food for the hungry, then a moment would be imagined; if the blind from birth knew the nature of jewels well, the world would be always.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If fire were food for the hungry, then a moment would be imagined; if the blind from birth knew the nature of jewels well, the world would be always.।

sanskrit: नपुंसककुमारस्य स्त्रीसुखं चेद्भवज्जगत् । निर्मितः शशशृङ्गेण रथश्चेज्जगदस्ति तत्
translit: napuṃsakakumārasya strīsukhaṃ cedbhavajjagat | nirmitaḥ śaśaśṛṅgeṇa rathaścejjagadasti tat
en: If a eunuch youth enjoyed a woman's pleasure, the world would be; if a chariot were built from a hare's horn, that world exists.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a eunuch youth enjoyed a woman's pleasure, the world would be; if a chariot were built from a hare's horn, that world exists.।

sanskrit: सद्योजाता तु या कन्या भोगयोग्या भवेज्जगत् । वन्ध्या गर्भाप्ततत्सौख्यं ज्ञाता चेदस्त्विदं जगत्
translit: sadyojātā tu yā kanyā bhogayogyā bhavejjagat | vandhyā garbhāptatatsaukhyaṃ jñātā cedastvidaṃ jagat
en: If a girl newly born were fit for enjoyment, the world would be; if a barren woman knew the happiness of pregnancy, let this world be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a girl newly born were fit for enjoyment, the world would be; if a barren woman knew the happiness of pregnancy, let this world be.।

sanskrit: काको वा हंसवद्गच्छेज्जगद्भवतु निश्चलम् । महाखरो वा सिंहेन युध्यते चेज्जगत्स्थितिः
translit: kāko vā haṃsavadgacchejjagadbhavatu niścalam | mahākharo vā siṃhena yudhyate cejjagatsthitiḥ
en: If a crow walked like a swan, let the world be steady; if a great ass fought with a lion, then the world's continuance would hold.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a crow walked like a swan, let the world be steady; if a great ass fought with a lion, then the world's continuance would hold.।

sanskrit: महाखरो गजगतिं गतश्चेज्जगदस्तु तत् । सम्पूर्णचन्द्रसूर्यश्चेज्जगद्भातु स्वयं जडम्
translit: mahākharo gajagatiṃ gataścejjagadastu tat | sampūrṇacandrasūryaścejjagadbhātu svayaṃ jaḍam
en: If a great ass went with an elephant's gait, then let there be the world; if the full moon and sun were themselves dull, let the world shine.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a great ass went with an elephant's gait, then let there be the world; if the full moon and sun were themselves dull, let the world shine.।

sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्यादिकौ त्यक्त्वा राहुश्चेद्दृश्यते जगत् । भृष्टबीजसमुत्पन्नवृद्धिश्चेज्जगदस्तु सत्
translit: candrasūryādikau tyaktvā rāhuśceddṛśyate jagat | bhṛṣṭabījasamutpannavṛddhiścejjagadastu sat
en: If Rahu were seen leaving the moon and sun and the like, the world; if growth arose from a roasted seed, let the world be real.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If Rahu were seen leaving the moon and sun and the like, the world; if growth arose from a roasted seed, let the world be real.।

sanskrit: दरिद्रो धनिकानां च सुखं भुङ्क्ते तदा जगत् । शुना वीर्येण सिंहस्तु जितो यदि जगत्तदा
translit: daridro dhanikānāṃ ca sukhaṃ bhuṅkte tadā jagat | śunā vīryeṇa siṃhastu jito yadi jagattadā
en: If a poor man enjoyed the happiness of the wealthy, then the world would be; if a dog by its strength conquered a lion, then the world would be.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a poor man enjoyed the happiness of the wealthy, then the world would be; if a dog by its strength conquered a lion, then the world would be.।

sanskrit: ज्ञानिनो हृदयं मूढैर्ज्ञातं चेत्कल्पनं तदा । श्वानेन सागरे पीते निःशेषेण मनो भवेत्
translit: jñānino hṛdayaṃ mūḍhairjñātaṃ cetkalpanaṃ tadā | śvānena sāgare pīte niḥśeṣeṇa mano bhavet
en: If the heart of the wise were known by fools, it would be imagination; if a dog drank the ocean entirely, then it would be mind.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If हृदय-गुहा of the wise were known by fools, it would be imagination; if a dog drank the ocean entirely, then it would be mind.।

sanskrit: शुद्धाकाशो मनुष्येषु पतितश्चेत्तदा जगत् । भूमौ वा पतितं व्योम व्योमपुष्पं सुगन्धकम्
translit: śuddhākāśo manuṣyeṣu patitaścettadā jagat | bhūmau vā patitaṃ vyoma vyomapuṣpaṃ sugandhakam
en: If pure space fell among men, then the world; or if the sky fell on earth, a sky-flower would be fragrant.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If pure space fell among men, then the world; or if the sky fell on earth, a sky-flower would be fragrant.।

sanskrit: शुद्धाकाशे वने जाते चलिते तु तदा जगत् । केवले दर्पणे नास्ति प्रतिबिम्बं तदा जगत्
translit: śuddhākāśe vane jāte calite tu tadā jagat | kevale darpaṇe nāsti pratibimbaṃ tadā jagat
en: If a forest grew in pure space and moved, then the world; if there were a reflection in a bare mirror, then the world.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If a forest grew in pure space and moved, then the world; if there were a reflection in a bare mirror, then the world.।

sanskrit: अजकुक्षौ जगन्नास्ति ह्यात्मकुक्षौ जगन्नहि । सर्वथा भेदकलनं द्वैताद्वैतं न विद्यते
translit: ajakukṣau jagannāsti hyātmakukṣau jagannahi | sarvathā bhedakalanaṃ dvaitādvaitaṃ na vidyate
en: In the womb of the unborn there is no world; in the womb of the Self there is no world; in every way, imagining of difference, duality and non-duality does not exist.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: In the womb of the unborn there is no world; in the womb of आत्मा there is no world; in every way, imagining of difference, duality and non-duality does not exist.।

sanskrit: मायाकार्यमिदं भेदमस्ति चेद्ब्रह्मभावनम् । देहोऽहमिति दुःखं चेद्ब्रह्माहमिति निश्चयः
translit: māyākāryamidaṃ bhedamasti cedbrahmabhāvanam | deho'hamiti duḥkhaṃ cedbrahmāhamiti niścayaḥ
en: If this difference, the effect of illusion, exists, there is contemplation of Brahman; if "I am the body" is sorrow, the certainty is "I am Brahman."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If this difference, the effect of illusion, exists, there is contemplation of परब्रह्म; if "I am शरीर" is sorrow, the certainty is "I am परब्रह्म.।

sanskrit: हृदयग्रन्थिरस्तित्वे छिद्यते ब्रह्मचक्रकम् । संशये समनुप्राप्ते ब्रह्मनिश्चयमाश्रयेत्
translit: hṛdayagranthirastitve chidyate brahmacakrakam | saṃśaye samanuprāpte brahmaniścayamāśrayet
en: When the knot of the heart exists, the wheel of Brahman cuts it; when doubt arises, one should take refuge in the certainty of Brahman.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: When the knot of हृदय-गुहा exists, the wheel of परब्रह्म cuts it; when doubt arises, one should take refuge in the certainty of परब्रह्म.।

sanskrit: अनात्मरूपचोरश्चेदात्मरत्नस्य रक्षणम् । नित्यानन्दमयं ब्रह्म केवलं सर्वदा स्वयम्
translit: anātmarūpacoraścedātmaratnasya rakṣaṇam | nityānandamayaṃ brahma kevalaṃ sarvadā svayam
en: If the thief in the form of the non-Self exists, guard the jewel of the Self; Brahman, made of eternal bliss, alone, always by itself.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: If the thief in the form of the non-Self exists, guard the jewel of आत्मा; परब्रह्म, made of eternal bliss, alone, always by itself.।

sanskrit: एवमादिसुदृष्टान्तैः साधितं ब्रह्ममात्रकम् । ब्रह्मैव सर्वभवनं भुवनं नाम सन्त्यज
translit: evamādisudṛṣṭāntaiḥ sādhitaṃ brahmamātrakam | brahmaiva sarvabhavanaṃ bhuvanaṃ nāma santyaja
en: By such good examples Brahman alone is established; Brahman alone is all becoming — abandon the name "world."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: By such good examples परब्रह्म alone is established; परब्रह्म alone is all becoming — abandon the name "world.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मेति निश्चित्य अहम्भावं परित्यज । सर्वमेव लयं याति सुप्तहस्तस्थपुष्पवत्
translit: ahaṃ brahmeti niścitya ahambhāvaṃ parityaja | sarvameva layaṃ yāti suptahastasthapuṣpavat
en: Having ascertained "I am Brahman," give up the sense of "I"; everything goes to dissolution like a flower in the hand of one asleep.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Having ascertained "I am परब्रह्म," give up the sense of "I"; everything goes to dissolution like a flower in the hand of one asleep.।

sanskrit: न देहो न च कर्माणि सर्वं ब्रह्मैव केवलम् । न भूतं न च कार्यं च न चावस्थाचतुष्टयम्
translit: na deho na ca karmāṇi sarvaṃ brahmaiva kevalam | na bhūtaṃ na ca kāryaṃ ca na cāvasthācatuṣṭayam
en: No body, no actions: all is Brahman alone. No element, no effect, no fourfold state.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: No body, no actions: all is परब्रह्म alone. No element, no effect, no fourfold state.।

sanskrit: लक्षणात्रयविज्ञानं सर्वं ब्रह्मैव केवलम् । सर्वव्यापारमुत्सृज्य ह्यहं ब्रह्मेति भावय
translit: lakṣaṇātrayavijñānaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaiva kevalam | sarvavyāpāramutsṛjya hyahaṃ brahmeti bhāvaya
en: Knowledge of the three characteristics: all is Brahman alone; abandoning all activity, contemplate "I am Brahman."
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: ज्ञान of the three characteristics: all is परब्रह्म alone; abandoning all activity, contemplate "I am परब्रह्म.।

sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्म न सन्देहो ह्यहं ब्रह्म चिदात्मकम् । सच्चिदानन्दमात्रोऽहमिति निश्चित्य तत्त्यज
translit: ahaṃ brahma na sandeho hyahaṃ brahma cidātmakam | saccidānandamātro'hamiti niścitya tattyaja
en: I am Brahman — no doubt; I am Brahman, the Self of consciousness; having ascertained "I am mere being-consciousness-bliss," abandon even that.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: I am परब्रह्म — no doubt; I am परब्रह्म, आत्मा of चैतन्य; having ascertained "I am mere being-चैतन्य-bliss," abandon even that.।

sanskrit: शाङ्करीयं महाशास्त्रं न देयं यस्य कस्यचित् । नास्तिकाय कृतघ्नाय दुर्वृत्ताय दुरात्मने
translit: śāṅkarīyaṃ mahāśāstraṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit | nāstikāya kṛtaghnāya durvṛttāya durātmane
en: This great scripture in Shankara's line is not to be given to just anyone — not to the unbeliever, the ungrateful, the ill-behaved, the evil-minded.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: This great scripture in Shankara's line is not to be given to just anyone — not to the unbeliever, the ungrateful, the ill-behaved, the evil-minded.।

sanskrit: गुरुभक्तिविशुद्धान्तःकरणाय महात्मने । सम्यक्परीक्ष्य दातव्यं मासं षाण्मासवत्सरम्
translit: gurubhaktiviśuddhāntaḥkaraṇāya mahātmane | samyakparīkṣya dātavyaṃ māsaṃ ṣāṇmāsavatsaram
en: It should be given to the great-souled whose inner instrument is purified by devotion to the teacher, after careful testing for a month, six months or a year.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: It should be given to the great-souled whose inner instrument is purified by भक्ति to गुरुदेव, after careful testing for a month, six months or a year.।

sanskrit: सर्वोपनिषदभ्यासं दूरतस्त्यज्य सादरम् । तेजोबिन्दूपनिषदमभ्यसेत्सर्वदा मुदा
translit: sarvopaniṣadabhyāsaṃ dūratastyajya sādaram | tejobindūpaniṣadamabhyasetsarvadā mudā
en: Giving up with respect the study of all other Upanishads, one should always joyfully study the Tejobindu Upanishad.
hindi: उपनिषद् के उपदेशानुसार: Giving up with respect the study of all other Upanishads, one should always joyfully study the Tejobindu Upanishad.।
